title: Gen4P: Video Generators are 4D Perceivers
abstract: We introduce Gen4P, a unified framework for recovering 4D geometry and motion from monocular video. We show that a pretrained video generator can be repurposed into a feed-forward 4D perceiver without iterative denoising. Building on on-demand querying, Gen4P processes clean video latents in a single encoder pass and predicts the requested 4D attributes through a lightweight cross-attention decoder. The on-demand query formulation enables flexible spatial sampling, and our proposed continuous-time queries further provide temporal flexibility. To strengthen geometric knowledge, we propose a straightforward plug-in solution by incorporating a pretrained video-depth LoRA as a frozen geometry prior, improving overall performance without adding extra trainable parameters. Gen4P achieves state-of-the-art or competitive performance on tasks of 3D point tracking, video depth and camera pose estimation. Qualitative results on in-the-wild videos illustrate its capability of tracking complex motion while maintaining the delicate structure. Together, these results demonstrate the potential of video generative pretraining for unified 4D perception. See https://gen4p.github.io for more visual results.
tldr: Gen4P将预训练视频生成器改造为前馈4D感知器，从单目视频统一恢复4D几何与运动。
motivation: 研究动机是从单目视频中统一恢复4D几何与运动，并探索预训练视频生成器作为4D感知器的潜力，避免传统迭代去噪带来的高开销。
method: 基于按需查询，Gen4P对干净视频隐变量进行单次编码，并用轻量跨注意力解码器预测所需4D属性；连续时间查询提供时间灵活性，同时将预训练video-depth LoRA作为冻结几何先验即插即用，增强几何知识且不增加可训练参数。
result: 在3D点跟踪、视频深度和相机位姿估计任务上取得SOTA或具有竞争力的性能；在野外视频上可跟踪复杂运动并保持精细结构，但摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 结果表明视频生成预训练可用于统一4D感知，为从单目视频进行前馈4D几何与运动恢复提供了新思路，并展现跨任务泛化潜力。

title: DK-VLM: Geometry as Position for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
abstract: Vision-language models still struggle to understand 3D spatial relations across views and update spatial judgments as the observer moves. A common approach fuses 3D reconstruction features into visual tokens, but aligning these features with pretrained semantic representations remains challenging under limited spatial supervision. We propose DK-VLM with Dual-Kernel Attention, which computes attention from both a visual token's input position and its geometric position in the scene. A semantic kernel retains the pretrained model's native attention and positional encoding, while a separate geometric kernel uses estimated 3D points and camera poses to directly modulate attention through point displacements and relative view transformations. Then, a learned gate fuses their outputs. Geometry thus enters attention as position rather than as fused reconstruction features. We further introduce Reference-Frame Composition (RC) supervision to train the model to update its reference frame across successive judgments. It provides stepwise turn and heading targets derived from verified single-step annotations. Among the compared methods, DK-VLM-8B achieves the highest average score across six spatial benchmarks and the highest overall scores on VSI-Bench (74.33) and ReVSI-32 (58.28). RC supervision further improves multi-step spatial reasoning, while the full model preserves general video understanding. Project page: https://sumuru789.github.io/DK-VLM-website/.
tldr: DK-VLM 将几何位置作为注意力调制，结合双核注意力与参考系组合监督，提升视觉语言模型的空间推理能力。
motivation: 视觉语言模型仍难以理解跨视角的 3D 空间关系，并在观察者移动时更新空间判断。常见做法是将 3D 重建特征融合进视觉 token，但在有限空间监督下，这些特征与预训练语义表示的对齐仍很困难。
method: 提出 DK-VLM 与 Dual-Kernel Attention：语义核保留预训练模型的原始注意力与位置编码，几何核利用估计的 3D 点和相机位姿，通过点位移与相对视角变换直接调制注意力，再由学习门融合二者，使几何以位置形式进入注意力而非作为融合的重建特征。进一步引入 Reference-Frame Composition 监督，基于已验证的单步标注生成逐步转向与朝向目标，训练模型在连续判断中更新参考系。
result: DK-VLM-8B 在六个空间基准上取得最高平均分，并在 VSI-Bench 与 ReVSI-32 上分别达到最高总分 74.33 和 58.28。RC 监督进一步提升了多步空间推理能力，同时完整模型保持了通用视频理解性能。
conclusion: DK-VLM 通过将几何作为位置调制注意力，并利用 RC 监督更新参考系，有效增强了视觉语言模型的空间推理与多步空间判断能力。该工作为 VLM 的 3D 空间理解提供了新思路，并在保持通用视频理解的同时取得空间基准领先结果。

title: Motion- and Gravity-Aware Feedforward 3D Reconstruction
abstract:
Feed-forward transformer models have recently achieved strong performance in multi-view 3D reconstruction, but they still rely primarily on appearance-based attention and often struggle in dynamic scenes with weak geometric cues. In this work, we introduce a motion- and gravity-aware framework under the Learning Using Privileged Information (LUPI) paradigm. During training, residual optical flow and gravity direction are provided as privileged signals to guide geometric representation learning; during inference, the model uses standard visual inputs only.
  We integrate these priors into transformer backbones with lightweight architectural changes, preserving feed-forward efficiency. Experiments on standard benchmarks show consistent gains in reconstruction accuracy and robustness, especially in scenes with dynamic objects, ambiguous structure, and challenging camera motion. Our analysis further shows that the optimal injection stage is backbone-dependent: middle-layer integration is generally preferable for VGGT, while late-stage integration is more effective for π3. These results suggest that LUPI offers a practical way to inject motion and physical priors into feed-forward 3D reconstruction without increasing test-time complexity.
tldr: 提出运动与重力感知的前馈3D重建框架，用LUPI在训练时注入光流和重力先验，推理不增加复杂度并提升动态场景鲁棒性。
motivation: 前馈Transformer多视图3D重建性能强，但主要依赖外观注意力，在动态场景和几何线索薄弱时表现不佳。该工作旨在不增加推理代价的前提下，为前馈重建注入运动与物理先验。
method: 在LUPI范式下，训练时将残差光流和重力方向作为特权信息，通过轻量架构修改注入Transformer主干以引导几何表征学习；推理时仅使用标准视觉输入，保持前馈效率。并分析不同主干的先验注入阶段。
result: 在标准基准上，重建精度和鲁棒性获得一致提升，尤其在动态物体、结构歧义和困难相机运动场景。消融显示最佳注入阶段依赖主干：VGGT通常中间层更优，π3则后期融合更有效。
conclusion: 表明LUPI可将运动与物理先验有效注入前馈3D重建，提升动态场景性能且不增加测试时复杂度。贡献在于提出运动/重力感知框架并揭示注入阶段的主干依赖性，为后续多视图重建提供实用思路。

title: Edit4D: Editable 4D Scene Generation with Textual Control
abstract: We introduce Edit4D, an editable text-to-4D scene generation framework that constructs 4D scenes from separate background and dynamic character representations. Recent advances in generative models have enabled text-driven dynamic scene synthesis, but editable 4D scene generation remains challenging due to the need to preserve spatial geometry and temporal dynamics. Existing approaches typically generate holistic scene videos, where the background and dynamic characters are coupled, making object-level editing and flexible camera control difficult. Edit4D addresses these limitations through a stage-specific generation pipeline. Given a user instruction, Edit4D first decomposes it into stage-specific prompts for background, dynamic character, and scene-character composition. Using these prompts, we synthesize multi-view scene images with text-to-image and camera-conditioned generative priors and reconstruct a background 3D Gaussian splatting representation. We then generate a character image, animate it with an image-conditioned video prior, reconstruct a 4D mesh, and bind Gaussian primitives to obtain a character representation. Finally, both components are composed through text-guided segmentation and contact-aware optimization. A global scene refinement is then performed to improve harmonization and rendering consistency. By integrating stage-specific components, Edit4D enables controllable camera motion, flexible object-level editing, and the practical construction of editable 4D scenes. Project page: https://chanwo0kim.github.io/Edit4D/
tldr: Edit4D提出分阶段文本到4D场景生成框架，通过分离背景与动态角色表示实现可编辑4D场景与可控相机运动。
motivation: 现有文本驱动动态场景生成方法通常生成整体场景视频，背景与动态角色耦合，难以进行对象级编辑和灵活相机控制。Edit4D旨在解决可编辑4D场景生成中保持空间几何与时间动态的难题。
method: Edit4D采用分阶段生成流程：先将用户指令分解为背景、动态角色及场景-角色组合的提示；利用文本到图像和相机条件生成先验合成多视角场景图像并重建背景3D高斯溅射表示；生成角色图像并用图像条件视频先验驱动动画，重建4D网格并绑定高斯基元；通过文本引导分割和接触感知优化组合两部分，最后进行全局场景细化以提升协调性与渲染一致性。
result: 摘要未提供相关信息
conclusion: Edit4D通过分阶段组件集成，实现了可控相机运动、灵活的对象级编辑以及可编辑4D场景的实用构建，为文本驱动的动态场景编辑提供了新方案。

title: Anchor3DGS: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting with Compact Anchor-Based Representation
abstract: Recent feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods have enabled effective multi-view 3D reconstruction by predicting Gaussian primitives in a single forward pass. However, existing approaches predominantly adopt a pixel-aligned paradigm that predicts one Gaussian per input pixel, coupling the Gaussian count to the input resolution and number of views. This also leads to redundant primitives in textureless regions and insufficient coverage in geometrically complex areas. We present Anchor3DGS, a pose-free feed-forward 3DGS framework that replaces pixel-aligned prediction with a compact anchor-based representation. Guided by information entropy, our method places a set of 3D anchors in the scene, concentrating them in regions of higher visual complexity while maintaining broad spatial coverage. Each anchor performs occlusion-aware aggregation of multi-view image features, exchanges information with other anchors, and is decoded into a set of local Gaussians. A lightweight feature enhancement module further refines the coarse RGB output from Gaussian splatting and improves rendering fidelity. Extensive experiments on diverse benchmark datasets demonstrate that our Anchor3DGS achieves state-of-the-art novel view synthesis quality while only using an order of magnitude fewer Gaussian primitives.
tldr: 提出Anchor3DGS，无位姿前馈3DGS，用紧凑锚点表示减少高斯数量并提升新视角合成质量。
motivation: 现有前馈3DGS方法多采用逐像素对齐范式，每个输入像素预测一个高斯，使高斯数量与输入分辨率和视角数耦合，并在纹理缺失区域产生冗余、在几何复杂区域覆盖不足。本文旨在以更紧凑的表示替代逐像素预测，解决冗余与覆盖不均问题。
method: Anchor3DGS是一个无位姿前馈3DGS框架，利用信息熵引导在场景中放置3D锚点，使其集中于高视觉复杂度区域并保持空间覆盖。每个锚点进行遮挡感知的多视角特征聚合、锚点间信息交换，并解码为一组局部高斯；轻量特征增强模块进一步细化高斯泼溅的粗略RGB输出。
result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，Anchor3DGS在新视角合成质量上达到最先进水平，同时仅使用少一个数量级的高斯图元。
conclusion: 该工作证明紧凑锚点表示可有效替代像素对齐范式，显著减少高斯冗余并改善复杂区域覆盖与渲染保真度，为高效前馈3DGS重建提供了新方向。

title: Training-Free Target-Aware Refinement of 3D Gaussian Language Map
abstract: Distilling vision-language features into 3D Gaussian Splatting yields a language map that can be queried with arbitrary text. In deployment, however, a small set of user-specified targets must be reliably located, which current distilled maps often miss, while open-vocabulary queryability for other words must remain intact. We propose a training-free, target-aware refinement of an already-distilled language map. Guided by a text-promptable segmenter, the visual embedding inside each detected target region is blended with the target text embedding, a convex combination whose coefficient sets the amount of injected prior, while non-target regions are left untouched. Injecting too much overwrites appearance cues and general queryability, so we seek, for each target, the smallest coefficient that still lets it win, and we obtain every coefficient in closed form, leaving no hyperparameters to tune. We further identify a failure mode of injection in language-goal localization. Text embeddings share a common component, and injecting them makes the standard cosine read-out query-agnostic, which a centering step in the read-out removes. Across three benchmarks, the refinement consistently improves open-vocabulary segmentation, roughly doubling the base mIoU on Replica, and localizes language goals more reliably than the base map. It also transfers as a plug-in to off-the-shelf field-based and object-level language maps and supports a real-world demonstration in which a legged robot navigates to natural-language goals. Project page and code: https://lab-of-ai-and-robotics.github.io/target-aware-langmap/
tldr: 提出免训练目标感知细化3D高斯语言地图，通过闭式系数融合文本嵌入提升目标定位与开放词汇分割，并支持机器人导航。
motivation: 现有将视觉语言特征蒸馏到3D Gaussian Splatting得到的语言地图，虽支持任意文本查询，但在部署中常无法可靠定位少量用户指定目标，同时还需保持对其他词的开放词汇查询能力。
method: 提出免训练的目标感知细化：用文本提示分割器定位目标区域，将区域内视觉嵌入与目标文本嵌入做凸组合，非目标区域不变；对每个目标闭式求解仍能胜出的最小注入系数，无需超参。还发现文本嵌入的共同分量会使标准余弦读出与查询无关，并通过读出端中心化消除该失败模式。
result: 在三个基准上持续提升开放词汇分割，Replica 上 mIoU 约翻倍，语言目标定位比基础地图更可靠；可作为插件迁移到 field-based 和对象级语言地图，并支持四足机器人导航到自然语言目标的真实演示。
conclusion: 该方法无需训练与调参即可提升目标定位和通用查询能力，增强了3D高斯语言地图的部署实用性，并为机器人语言目标导航提供可扩展方案。

title: AVALON: Zero-Shot Indoor Navigation with Human-Seeded Topological Memory
abstract: Indoor service robots often enter unmapped buildings whose layouts and task constraints are already familiar to users. We address this human-familiar, robot-unseen setting with AVALON, a topological navigation framework organized around human-seeded layered spatial memory, node-verified topological execution, and task-triggered, evidence-gated human--robot memory co-updating. The robot has no prior on-site traversal or site-specific training. Deployment requires only a floor plan, place clues, and an initial topology-odometry alignment. Visual depth point-goal navigation leverages verified node arrivals to perform translational re-anchoring, without requiring a robot-constructed global SLAM map. Human--robot memory co-updating fuses complementary sources of information. Human operators specify task constraints that are unobservable via vision and report offline environmental modifications, whereas the robot provides physical-state evidence through active in-situ validation. Task relevance governs whether human-reported environmental changes undergo robot validation during the active mission. Field-collected perceptual evidence gates memory updates, maintaining an explicit separation between human-specified permissions and robot-observed traversability. Our experiments on a Unitree Go2 show that AVALON with X-NavDP completes a 12.81 m Intersection-to-Dining mission in 46.4 s (5/5) with no mapping, 40.9% less robot time than DimOS-Go2 (78.5 s, 4/5), while policy-only X-NavDP times out in all of the 5 runs. These demonstrate the superiority of the proposed topological navigation framework.
tldr: AVALON利用人类播种的分层拓扑记忆与证据门控协同更新，实现无需建图的零样本室内导航。
motivation: 室内服务机器人常需进入未建图但用户已熟悉的建筑，且面临视觉不可观测的任务约束与离线环境变更。论文旨在解决机器人无现场遍历、无站点特定训练情况下，如何利用人类先验知识实现可靠室内导航的问题。
method: AVALON是一个拓扑导航框架，包含人类播种的分层空间记忆、节点验证的拓扑执行，以及任务触发、证据门控的人机记忆协同更新。部署仅需平面图、地点线索和初始拓扑-里程计对齐；视觉深度点目标导航借助已验证节点到达进行平移重锚定，无需机器人构建全局SLAM地图。人操作员指定视觉不可观测的任务约束并报告离线环境变更，机器人通过主动原位验证提供物理状态证据，任务相关性决定人类报告的环境变化是否需机器人验证，感知证据门控记忆更新并显式区分人类指定权限与机器人观测可通行性。
result: 在Unitree Go2上的实验中，AVALON结合X-NavDP完成12.81 m的Intersection-to-Dining任务耗时46.4 s（成功率5/5），无需建图，机器人耗时比DimOS-Go2（78.5 s，4/5）减少40.9%；而仅使用策略的X-NavDP在5次运行中均超时。
conclusion: 结果表明AVALON拓扑导航框架在零样本、无建图室内导航中优于基线，并验证了人类先验记忆与机器人证据门控协同更新的有效性。其贡献在于降低部署对现场建图和训练的需求，提升服务机器人在人类熟悉、机器人未见环境中的任务适应性与导航效率。

title: CLAD: Keypoint Matching Using Global Line Correspondences
abstract: Traditional keypoint descriptors, such as SIFT (Scale-Invariant Feature Transform) and ORB (Oriented FAST and Rotated BRIEF), are computed from local image patches. They may be unreliable in scenes with repetitive patterns or weak textures, where patches at different locations can look similar. We propose the Contextual Line-Assisted Descriptor (CLAD), a keypoint matching method that addresses this problem by using global geometric context from line correspondences. CLAD represents each keypoint with a vector whose elements indicate its proximity to matched lines. It can therefore use the keypoint's spatial relationships to the lines in the scene. We use HOME (Hough-space One-dimensional Matching of Extrema) to detect both clear and weak linear structures and to establish enough line-to-keypoint associations to represent this context. Evaluations on the TUM RGB-D SLAM dataset and outdoor video sequences show that CLAD provides geometrically consistent matches that complement those obtained with traditional local descriptors. In repetitive scenes, where local descriptors may not distinguish similar patches, CLAD uses global structure to improve matching reliability. The method is computationally lightweight and practical to implement.
tldr: CLAD利用全局线对应关系构建关键点描述子，以提升重复纹理场景下的匹配可靠性。
motivation: 传统SIFT、ORB等局部关键点描述子仅依赖局部图像块，在重复模式或弱纹理场景中不同位置图像块相似，导致匹配不可靠，因此需要引入全局几何上下文。
method: 提出CLAD，将每个关键点表示为到已匹配直线的邻近度向量，从而编码其与场景中直线的全局空间关系；并使用HOME在Hough空间检测强弱线性结构，建立足够的线-关键点关联以表示该上下文。
result: 在TUM RGB-D SLAM数据集和户外视频序列上评估，CLAD能提供几何一致的匹配，补充传统局部描述子，并在重复场景中借助全局结构提高匹配可靠性；方法计算轻量、易于实现。摘要未给出具体量化指标。
conclusion: CLAD表明全局线对应可为关键点匹配提供有效几何上下文，改善局部描述子在重复或弱纹理场景中的不足，且计算开销低，具有实际应用潜力。

title: GeoPano: Towards Geometrically Accurate 3D Reconstruction from a Single Panorama
abstract: Panoramic 3D reconstruction enables the holistic recovery of complete 360 $^\circ$ scene geometry, offering significant benefits for robotics and AR/VR applications. However, directly estimating geometry from ERP images is inherently challenged by spherical distortions. To reduce spherical projection distortions, a common strategy is to decompose panoramas into distortion-free perspective views, but independently processing these views often introduces cross-view geometric inconsistencies. To address these challenges, we introduce GeoPano, a feed-forward framework for single-view panoramic 3D reconstruction that recovers a geometrically accurate and consistent point cloud from a single panorama. Our approach is driven by two key innovations: First, we propose a panoramic-aware attention aggregator, featuring a streamlined attention architecture equipped with a novel Pano-Attention mechanism, which explicitly exploits the intrinsic spherical geometry of the panorama to guide cross-view interactions, thereby suppressing geometric inconsistencies. Furthermore, we formulate a hybrid supervision strategy to jointly enforce fine-grained local details in perspective space and global structural coherence in spherical space. Experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms previous SOTA approaches in reconstruction accuracy, geometric consistency, and visual fidelity.
tldr: GeoPano 用全景感知注意力和混合监督，从单张全景图重建几何准确且一致的点云。
motivation: 单张全景图可整体恢复360°场景几何，对机器人和AR/VR很有价值，但ERP图像的球面畸变使直接估计几何困难；拆成无畸变透视视图分别处理又会引入跨视图几何不一致。
method: 提出GeoPano前馈框架，从单张全景图恢复几何准确且一致的点云。核心包括带Pano-Attention的全景感知注意力聚合器，利用全景内在球面几何引导跨视图交互以抑制不一致，并采用混合监督在透视空间约束局部细节、在球面空间约束全局结构一致性。
result: 实验表明GeoPano在重建精度、几何一致性和视觉保真度上显著优于此前SOTA方法；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: GeoPano通过显式利用全景球面几何与混合监督，缓解了球面畸变和跨视图不一致问题，实现了单视图全景三维重建的几何准确与一致，对机器人和AR/VR应用具有潜在影响。

title: ResStreamGS: Residual-Sensitive Dual-Stream Gaussian Splatting for Mobile Volumetric Video Streaming
abstract: Real-time mobile volumetric video enables immersive free-viewpoint experiences, but delivering high-quality 3D content under constrained bandwidth and computation remains challenging. Recent 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) systems, such as V$^3$, enable efficient mobile streaming by encoding time-varying Gaussian attributes with commodity video codecs and hardware decoding. However, existing pipelines treat all Gaussians as frame-varying signals, which is poorly suited to full-scene content where large portions remain temporally stable. Our empirical study shows that frame-wise adaptation and video coding of all Gaussians cause quality degradation in complex full-scene content, particularly in temporally stable regions. To address this issue, we propose ResStreamGS, a residual-sensitive dual-stream framework that processes Gaussians according to their temporal behavior. ResStreamGS identifies residual-sensitive primitives through lightweight probe adaptation and reuses stable Gaussians within each Group of Pictures (GOP). Stable Gaussians are transmitted once per GOP, while only residual-sensitive Gaussians remain in the frame-wise hardware-decodable video stream. Experiments on complex full-scene volumetric videos show that ResStreamGS improves post-codec PSNR by 7.51--8.35~dB over a controlled V$^3$-style all-Gaussians baseline, reduces amortized payload by up to 56.5%, and achieves 30.883~FPS on a Qualcomm Snapdragon 778G platform.
tldr: ResStreamGS提出残差敏感双流框架，按高斯时序行为分流编码，提升移动体视频流质量并降低带宽。
motivation: 现有3DGS移动流媒体方案（如V³）将所有高斯视为逐帧变化信号，对包含大量时序稳定区域的全场景内容适配与视频编码效果差，导致稳定区域质量下降。
method: ResStreamGS通过轻量级探针自适应识别残差敏感图元，在GOP内复用稳定高斯（每GOP仅传输一次），仅将残差敏感高斯保留在逐帧硬件可解码视频流中，形成双流框架。
result: 在复杂全场景体视频上，后编码PSNR较受控V³式全高斯基线提升7.51–8.35 dB，摊销负载最多降低56.5%，并在高通骁龙778G平台达到30.883 FPS。

title: RoboCloth: A Large-Scale Real Cloth Material Dataset for Neural Reflectance Reconstruction
abstract: We present RoboCloth, a dataset of 500 real cloth materials captured under flexible, calibrated camera and lighting configurations, where both are robotically controlled during acquisition. Each material is imaged in approximately 580 high-dynamic range frames spanning a wide view-light hemisphere; camera poses are refined via structure-from-motion and aligned to the robot frame, yielding per-material sparse surface geometry and structured per-point reflectance observations ready for neural material training. We demonstrate the value of this data through a two-stage neural reconstruction pipeline: Stage 1 trains a shared MLP decoder on our corpus to learn cloth material priors; Stage 2 then freezes the decoder and fits a dense 2048x2048 latent texture to each target material. Evaluating on held-out materials from our own dataset and on the independent UBO2014 benchmark, we show that a decoder trained on our captures outperforms decoders trained on existing measured reflectance datasets and analytic PBR fitting, transferring to unseen acquisition systems without modification. The dataset, calibration files, observation tensors, and train/test splits are released under CC BY 4.0 on the Hugging Face Hub.
tldr: RoboCloth发布500种真实布料的大规模机器人采集数据集，并验证其可训练出可迁移的神经材质重建解码器。
motivation: 神经材质重建依赖大规模、标定准确的真实反射率数据，而现有实测数据集在布料材质覆盖度、视角-光照采样范围与机器人可复现采集方面均存在不足。
method: 通过机器人同时控制标定相机与光源，对每种布料采集约580张覆盖宽视角-光照半球的高动态范围图像，经SfM精化相机位姿并对齐机器人坐标系，得到每材质稀疏表面几何与结构化逐点反射观测；重建采用两阶段流程，Stage 1在本语料上训练共享MLP解码器学习布料材质先验，Stage 2冻结解码器并为每个目标材质拟合2048x2048密集潜纹理。
result: 数据集包含500种真实布料、每材质约580帧HDR观测；在本数据集留出材质与独立UBO2014基准上，本数据集训练的解码器均优于现有实测反射率数据集训练的解码器与解析PBR拟合，且无需修改即可迁移到未见过的采集系统。
conclusion: 该工作提供了大规模真实布料反射率数据集及配套标定文件、观测张量和训练/测试划分，并以CC BY 4.0在Hugging Face Hub公开，为神经材质重建提供可复现的数据基础与可迁移先验。

title: RoPE-Flow: Monocular Vision-based Robot Pose Estimation via 2D Graph-Conditioned 3D Flow Matching
abstract: Camera-to-robot pose estimation from a monocular image is significant for vision-based robot navigation and control. However, recovering 3D structural features from 2D observations remains a challenging task. Existing camera-to-robot pose estimation methods either rely on time-consuming iterative rendering or involve sophisticated 2D-3D registration which suffers from projection ambiguity, accumulated errors for distal joints and imbalanced learning for different joints. In this work, we propose RoPE-Flow, an end-to-end flow matching-based framework for camera-to-robot pose estimation. From the predicted 2D heatmaps, we propose a Keypoint-centered Feature Extractor to obtain positional features along with contextual representations from keypoints-centered multi-scale patches. Moreover, we introduce Graph-guided Condition Generator, which embeds a learnable adjacency map to generate condition for flow matching based on correlation among keypoints. Besides, we introduce Bone Length Loss and Ray-Depth Loss for topological consistency and scale stability, with joint-wise weighting to mitigate varied prediction difficulty across joints. The proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art methods for pose estimation across different types of robots with mutiple cameras. Besides, we establish a novel cross-scene benchmark to demonstrate the outstanding performance of RoPE-Flow on zero-shot cross-scene robot pose estimation. Meanwhile, animated visualizations are shown on the website: ropeflow.netlify.app
tldr: RoPE-Flow 基于 2D 图条件 3D 流匹配，从单目图像端到端估计机器人位姿。
motivation: 单目图像相机到机器人位姿估计对视觉导航与控制重要，但从 2D 观测恢复 3D 结构仍困难；现有方法依赖耗时迭代渲染或复杂 2D-3D 配准，存在投影歧义、远端关节误差累积和关节学习不均衡问题。
method: 提出端到端流匹配框架 RoPE-Flow：基于预测 2D 热图，用 Keypoint-centered Feature Extractor 提取关键点中心多尺度块的位置与上下文特征；用 Graph-guided Condition Generator 嵌入可学习邻接图，按关键点相关性生成流匹配条件；并引入 Bone Length Loss 与 Ray-Depth Loss 及关节加权，保障拓扑一致性与尺度稳定性。
result: 在多种机器人与多相机配置下，RoPE-Flow 的位姿估计性能优于现有 SOTA；还建立新的跨场景基准，展示其在零样本跨场景机器人位姿估计上的突出表现，但摘要未给出具体量化指标。
conclusion: RoPE-Flow 以 2D 图条件 3D 流匹配实现端到端单目机器人位姿估计，缓解投影歧义与关节不平衡，并推动零样本跨场景泛化；可视化见 ropeflow.netlify.app。

title: Motion- and Gravity-Aware Feedforward 3D Reconstruction
abstract: Feed-forward transformer models have recently achieved strong performance in multi-view 3D reconstruction, but they still rely primarily on appearance-based attention and often struggle in dynamic scenes with weak geometric cues. In this work, we introduce a motion- and gravity-aware framework under the Learning Using Privileged Information (LUPI) paradigm. During training, residual optical flow and gravity direction are provided as privileged signals to guide geometric representation learning; during inference, the model uses standard visual inputs only. We integrate these priors into transformer backbones with lightweight architectural changes, preserving feed-forward efficiency. Experiments on standard benchmarks show consistent gains in reconstruction accuracy and robustness, especially in scenes with dynamic objects, ambiguous structure, and challenging camera motion. Our analysis further shows that the optimal injection stage is backbone-dependent: middle-layer integration is generally preferable for VGGT, while late-stage integration is more effective for {\pi}3. These results suggest that LUPI offers a practical way to inject motion and physical priors into feed-forward 3D reconstruction without increasing test-time complexity.
tldr: 提出基于LUPI的运动与重力先验前馈三维重建框架，在不增加推理复杂度下提升动态场景鲁棒性。
motivation: 现有前馈Transformer多视图三维重建主要依赖外观注意力，在动态场景和弱几何线索下仍易失败。本文旨在将运动与物理先验注入几何表征学习，同时保持推理阶段的标准视觉输入和前馈效率。
method: 在Learning Using Privileged Information范式下，训练时引入残差光流和重力方向作为特权信号指导几何表征学习，推理时仅使用标准视觉输入。通过轻量级架构改动将这些先验集成到Transformer骨干中，并分析不同骨干的最优注入阶段。
result: 在标准基准上取得一致的 reconstruction accuracy 与鲁棒性提升，尤其在动态物体、结构歧义和困难相机运动场景中表现更好；摘要未给出具体量化指标。分析表明最优注入阶段依赖骨干：VGGT通常适合中层注入，而π3更适合后期注入。
conclusion: 结果表明LUPI为前馈三维重建注入运动与物理先验提供了实用途径，且不增加测试时复杂度。注入阶段应随骨干架构调整，为后续架构感知的先验融合设计提供了依据。

title: Anchor3DGS: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting with Compact Anchor-Based Representation
abstract: Recent feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods have enabled effective multi-view 3D reconstruction by predicting Gaussian primitives in a single forward pass. However, existing approaches predominantly adopt a pixel-aligned paradigm that predicts one Gaussian per input pixel, coupling the Gaussian count to the input resolution and number of views. This also leads to redundant primitives in textureless regions and insufficient coverage in geometrically complex areas. We present Anchor3DGS, a pose-free feed-forward 3DGS framework that replaces pixel-aligned prediction with a compact anchor-based representation. Guided by information entropy, our method places a set of 3D anchors in the scene, concentrating them in regions of higher visual complexity while maintaining broad spatial coverage. Each anchor performs occlusion-aware aggregation of multi-view image features, exchanges information with other anchors, and is decoded into a set of local Gaussians. A lightweight feature enhancement module further refines the coarse RGB output from Gaussian splatting and improves rendering fidelity. Extensive experiments on diverse benchmark datasets demonstrate that our Anchor3DGS achieves state-of-the-art novel view synthesis quality while only using an order of magnitude fewer Gaussian primitives.
tldr: Anchor3DGS提出基于紧凑锚点的无位姿前馈3DGS，以熵引导锚点分布并用更少高斯基元实现SOTA新视角合成。
motivation: 现有前馈3DGS多采用像素对齐范式，每个输入像素预测一个高斯，导致高斯基元数量与输入分辨率和视角数耦合，在无纹理区域产生冗余、在几何复杂区域覆盖不足。
method: 提出无位姿前馈3DGS框架Anchor3DGS，用紧凑的3D锚点表示替代像素对齐预测；基于信息熵在视觉复杂度高区域集中放置锚点并保持空间覆盖，每个锚点进行遮挡感知的多视角特征聚合、锚点间信息交换并解码为局部高斯，最后用轻量特征增强模块细化高斯泼溅的粗RGB输出。
result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，Anchor3DGS达到SOTA新视角合成质量，同时仅使用少一个数量级的高斯基元。
conclusion: 该方法将高斯基元数量与输入分辨率和视角数解耦，减少无纹理区域冗余并改善复杂几何覆盖，为高效前馈3DGS提供了紧凑锚点表示的新路线。

title: GeoPano: Towards Geometrically Accurate 3D Reconstruction from a Single Panorama
abstract: Panoramic 3D reconstruction enables the holistic recovery of complete 360 $^\circ$ scene geometry, offering significant benefits for robotics and AR/VR applications. However, directly estimating geometry from ERP images is inherently challenged by spherical distortions. To reduce spherical projection distortions, a common strategy is to decompose panoramas into distortion-free perspective views, but independently processing these views often introduces cross-view geometric inconsistencies. To address these challenges, we introduce GeoPano, a feed-forward framework for single-view panoramic 3D reconstruction that recovers a geometrically accurate and consistent point cloud from a single panorama. Our approach is driven by two key innovations: First, we propose a panoramic-aware attention aggregator, featuring a streamlined attention architecture equipped with a novel Pano-Attention mechanism, which explicitly exploits the intrinsic spherical geometry of the panorama to guide cross-view interactions, thereby suppressing geometric inconsistencies. Furthermore, we formulate a hybrid supervision strategy to jointly enforce fine-grained local details in perspective space and global structural coherence in spherical space. Experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms previous SOTA approaches in reconstruction accuracy, geometric consistency, and visual fidelity.
tldr: GeoPano 以全景感知注意力与混合监督，从单张全景图前馈重建几何一致的点云。
motivation: 全景图可直接恢复360°场景几何，但ERP图像的球面畸变使几何估计困难；拆分为透视视图虽减轻畸变，却易造成跨视图几何不一致。GeoPano旨在从单张全景图同时获得几何准确且一致的点云。
method: 提出前馈框架GeoPano，采用Pano-Attention的全景感知注意力聚合器，利用全景内在球面几何引导跨视图交互以抑制不一致；并设计混合监督策略，在透视空间约束局部细节、在球面空间约束全局结构连贯性。
result: 实验表明GeoPano在重建精度、几何一致性和视觉保真度上显著优于此前SOTA；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: GeoPano为单张全景图的几何准确、一致三维重建提供了有效方案，有望促进机器人与AR/VR中的全景感知应用。

From the predicted 2D heatmaps, we propose a Keypoint-centered Feature Extractor to obtain positional features along with contextual representations from keypoints-centered multi-scale patches. Moreover, we introduce Graph-guided Condition Generator, which embeds a learnable adjacency map to generate condition for flow matching based on correlation among keypoints. Besides, we introduce Bone Length Loss and Ray-Depth Loss for topological consistency and scale stability, with joint-wise weighting to mitigate varied prediction difficulty across joints. The proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art methods for pose estimation across different types of robots with mutiple cameras. Besides, we establish a novel cross-scene benchmark to demonstrate the outstanding performance of RoPE-Flow on zero-shot cross-scene robot pose estimation. Meanwhile, animated visualizations are shown on the website: this http URL
tldr: 提出RoPE-Flow，用2D图条件3D流匹配实现单目机器人位姿估计。
motivation: 单目图像恢复机器人相机位姿对导航控制很重要，但从2D观测恢复3D结构仍困难；现有方法或依赖耗时迭代渲染，或采用复杂2D-3D配准，存在投影歧义、远端关节误差累积和关节学习不均衡问题。
method: RoPE-Flow是端到端流匹配框架：基于预测的2D热图，用Keypoint-centered Feature Extractor从关键点中心多尺度块提取位置与上下文特征；Graph-guided Condition Generator借助可学习邻接图按关键点相关性生成流匹配条件；并引入Bone Length Loss与Ray-Depth Loss及关节级加权，保证拓扑一致性和尺度稳定。
