conclusion: 该方法将图条件3D流匹配用于单目机器人位姿估计，缓解投影歧义与关节不均衡，并通过拓扑/尺度约束提升稳定性；跨场景零样本表现显示其泛化潜力。

title: Feed-Forward Multi-View Feature Coding for 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods enable efficient reconstruction of 3D scenes from sparse multi-view images in a single forward pass, without scene-specific optimization. However, existing feed-forward scene-coding pipelines first generate a complete Gaussian representation and then encode its geometry and appearance attributes separately, often involving non-differentiable operations. The resulting 'generate-then-compress' pipeline requires complex attribute-specific codec designs and limits rate-distortion performance by restricting the exploitation of cross-attribute redundancy. We propose multi-view feature coding for Gaussian splatting (MFGS), an end-to-end feed-forward framework for scene coding. Instead of compressing an explicit Gaussian representation, MFGS extracts multi-view features from the input images and encodes them into a compact bitstream. Through end-to-end rate-distortion training, MFGS learns compact multi-view features that jointly represent geometry and appearance, enabling the receiver to predict Gaussian attributes from the decoded features. We further introduce importance-guided Gaussian selection to accommodate different rendering budgets, allowing the receiver to adjust the number of Gaussians used for rendering from the same bitstream. Across RE10K, ACID, and DL3DV, MFGS achieves 99.76-99.86% bitrate savings over the generate-then-compress pipeline, as measured by BD-rate, while reducing total GMACs by 52-55% and providing an approximately 12 times end-to-end speedup.
tldr: MFGS提出端到端前馈多视图特征编码，替代先生成后压缩，实现3DGS场景高效编码与渲染。
motivation: 现有前馈3DGS压缩流程需先生成完整高斯表示再分别编码几何与外观属性，常含不可微操作，且难以利用跨属性冗余，限制率失真性能并增加编解码复杂度。
method: MFGS将输入图像提取为多视图特征并编码成紧凑码流，通过端到端率失真训练让特征联合表征几何与外观，接收端从解码特征预测高斯属性；并引入重要性引导的高斯选择，使接收端可在同一码流下调整渲染高斯数量。
result: 在RE10K、ACID和DL3DV上，MFGS相比generate-then-compress流程在BD-rate上节省99.76-99.86%码率，同时将总GMACs降低52-55%，并带来约12倍端到端加速。
conclusion: MFGS为前馈3DGS场景编码提供了端到端、可适应渲染预算的新范式，显著提升率失真与计算效率，对稀疏视图三维重建与压缩传输具有潜在影响。

title: Where Should the Gaussians Go? Reusable Label-Aware Allocation for Budget-Constrained Gaussian Splatting of Cinematic CT
abstract: Anatomical labels help 3D Gaussian splatting preserve vessels in cinematic renderings of CT, but the representation is still found by optimising each patient's scene, where densification decides where Gaussians go, while real-time displays cap their number. We address one part of this process: deciding where a fixed budget of B Gaussians should be placed. We propose a reusable, labelaware allocation front end that maps a patient's CT, labels and transfer function to a density over 2mm cells and draws exactly B positions from it without per-patient optimisation; the other Gaussian attributes are still fitted per patient. The front end is learned once from per-patient optimised scenes and implemented as a population-trained neural prior and an interpretable seven-parameter visibility-aware closed form (VACF). With identical attribute fitting on 20 held-out patients at 10K-100K Gaussians, both raise vessel-masked PSNR over uniform allocation by 4.5-7.1dB and over pruning a dense voxel-aligned model by 1.6-3.3dB. The neural prior does not differ significantly from per-patient optimised allocation at any budget, and VACF is within 0.6dB of it on vessels; on 19 external patients the neural prior again matches it on vessels and VACF is within 0.7dB. As an initialisation for position optimisation, VACF allocation beats per-patient densification on vessels at 10K Gaussians and, at 25K, reaches a higher vessel PSNR after 118s of optimisation than densification after 248s. Under altered rendering presets, VACF transfers to new colours and lighting but not to a label-free transfer function, whereas the neural prior shows the opposite pattern.
tldr: 提出可复用的标签感知高斯分配前端，在预算约束下为CT电影渲染选择高斯位置。
motivation: 解剖标签有助于3D高斯泼溅在CT电影渲染中保留血管，但现有表示需逐患者优化场景，且实时显示限制高斯数量；核心问题是在固定预算B下决定高斯应放置于何处。
method: 提出可复用、标签感知的分配前端，将患者CT、标签和传递函数映射为2mm单元上的密度并精确采样B个位置，无需逐患者优化，其他高斯属性仍逐患者拟合。该前端从逐患者优化场景中一次性学习，实现为群体训练的神经先验和可解释的七参数可见性感知闭式解（VACF）。
result: 在20例留出患者、10K-100K高斯预算下，两种方法将血管掩膜PSNR较均匀分配提升4.5-7.1dB，较稠密体素对齐模型剪枝提升1.6-3.3dB。神经先验在各预算下与逐患者优化分配无显著差异，VACF在血管上与其相差0.6dB以内；19例外部队列中神经先验仍匹配，VACF相差0.7dB以内。作为位置优化初始化，VACF在10K高斯时优于逐患者致密化，25K时优化118s的血管PSNR高于致密化248s。
conclusion: 标签感知的可复用分配能在不逐患者优化位置的情况下接近甚至匹配优化分配，并可作为初始化加速位置优化。VACF对颜色和光照等渲染预设具有迁移性，但不能迁移到无标签传递函数，而神经先验表现相反。

title: Why 3D Reconstruction Breaks Down on Under-Ice AUV Video, and How to Predict It
abstract: Reconstruction of 3D structures using under-ice AUV video footage has been inaccurate, although it is not certain whether this is due to shortcomings in the methods or an inherent deficiency of the capture system. We test four different models for reconstruction on the same Antarctic under-ice AUV video (Icefin, Kamb Ice Stream): classical feature matching SfM, differentiable photometric splatting, volumetric depth fusion, and a pose-free feed-forward foundation model. All four fail, each in a distinct way: near-total registration yielding almost no structure, geometrically broken output despite healthy photometric metrics, a persistent coverage artifact, and unstable cross-chunk scale. We show that all four are consistent with the same capture regime, a small camera-baseline-to-scene-depth ratio. Following our analysis, we propose a detection system that flags this type of failure in minutes, rather than hours of wasted compute.
tldr: 冰下AUV视频上四种3D重建方法均失败，根源是相机基线-场景深度比过小，作者提出可在数分钟内预警的失败检测系统。
motivation: 冰下AUV视频的三维重建长期不准确，但尚不确定这是重建方法缺陷还是采集系统固有不足；该工作旨在厘清失败机制并预测此类失败。
method: 在相同的南极冰下AUV视频（Icefin, Kamb Ice Stream）上系统对比经典特征匹配SfM、可微光度splatting、体深度融合和无位姿前馈基础模型，并分析四种失败模式与采集条件的关系，进而提出失败检测系统。
result: 四种方法全部失败且失败方式不同：近乎无配准/无结构、光度指标看似健康但几何破碎、持续覆盖伪影、跨块尺度不稳定；这些现象均与相机基线-场景深度比过小这一采集状态一致。作者提出的检测系统可在数分钟内标记失败，而非耗费数小时计算。
conclusion: 研究表明冰下AUV三维重建失败并非仅由单一算法造成，而可能源于小相机基线-场景深度比的采集局限；所提快速检测可用于提前预警、避免无效计算，并指导冰下AUV视频采集与重建流程。

title: VisibilitySplat: Ray-Traced Occlusion for Relighting with 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: We address inverse rendering with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) by introducing explicit visibility modeling for relighting as well as material and light decomposition. Our approach augments the standard rasterized 3DGS pipeline with a sparse visibility oracle that estimates transmittance-weighted occlusion for Gaussian primitives from sampled lighting directions. This oracle is implemented using a point-based ray tracer accelerated by a bounding volume hierarchy (BVH) and queried sparsely within the inverse-rendering objectives, while the original 3DGS loop is retained for training efficiency, interactive visualization, and tooling compatibility. Shading follows a physically based rendering (PBR) formulation with a principled microfacet bidirectional reflectance distribution function (BRDF) and low-resolution high-dynamic-range (HDR) environment maps. We evaluate our method on the TensoIR synthetic dataset against baselines based on neural radiance fields (NeRFs), tensor representations, and 3DGS. The results show competitive performance and improvements over several earlier baselines for novel-view synthesis (NVS), albedo reconstruction, and relighting. Ablations indicate that explicit visibility modeling is an important contributor to relighting and material-illumination disentanglement, while pure PBR supervision can favor appearance fitting in NVS. Overall, the findings suggest that sparse, point-based visibility queries effectively complement rasterized splatting for inverse rendering while preserving the practical advantages of the 3DGS ecosystem.
tldr: 提出 VisibilitySplat，用稀疏点光线追踪显式建模可见性，增强 3DGS 逆渲染的重光照与材质光照分解。
motivation: 3DGS 在逆渲染中缺乏显式可见性建模，导致重光照与材质-光照分解困难，同时需保留 3DGS 的高效训练与交互可视化优势。
method: 在标准光栅化 3DGS 流程上引入稀疏可见性 oracle，用 BVH 加速的点光线追踪估计高斯图元沿采样光照方向的透射率加权遮挡，并在逆渲染目标中稀疏查询；着色采用基于微表面 BRDF 与低分辨率 HDR 环境图的 PBR 公式。
result: 在 TensoIR 合成数据集上与 NeRF、张量表示和 3DGS 基线对比，在新视角合成、反照率重建和重光照上取得有竞争力且优于多个早期基线的结果；消融表明显式可见性建模对重光照和材质-光照解耦贡献显著，而纯 PBR 监督在 NVS 中可能偏向外观拟合。
conclusion: 表明稀疏点式可见性查询能有效补充光栅化 splatting 用于逆渲染，同时保留 3DGS 生态在训练效率、交互可视化和工具兼容性方面的实用优势。

title: HyperLoop: Hyperspectral-Assisted Loop Closure Detection in 3D-SLAM for Planetary Exploration
abstract: Autonomous navigation of planetary rovers is challenged by visually repetitive, featureless terrain. SLAM systems based on 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) offer dense mapping but rely on RGB appearance descriptors that degrade under perceptual aliasing - a common failure mode in extraterrestrial environments where physically distinct locations appear visually identical. This paper presents HyperLoop, the first framework integrating hyperspectral imaging (HSI) into the loop closure module of a 3DGS-based SLAM system. Hyperspectral descriptors encode material-level spectral signatures complementing RGB features, providing robustness to illumination changes and visual repetitiveness. Two HSI descriptor families are introduced: Bag-of-Spectral-Words (BoSW), encoding spectral material distributions via TF-IDF weighted histograms, and PCA-K VLAD (PCAK-VLAD), capturing first-order residual statistics of PCA-compressed spectral signatures. Both are evaluated with SIFT-VLAD and NetVLAD RGB descriptors under Strict-AND and Weighted fusion strategies on a custom dataset from the Moon-Mars Outdoor Test Site (MMOTS) at DLR, comprising synchronized RGB-D and hyperspectral sequences across four planetary analog traverses (65.5 m total). A key finding is that the sensor's Red-NIR range (600-860 nm) provides limited discriminability for rock terrain: the best HSI fusion (SIFT-VLAD + BoSW, Strict-AND) achieves 5.04 cm ATE RMSE, within 1.8% of SIFT-VLAD alone (4.95 cm). The gain over NetVLAD (8.81 cm) is attributable to SIFT-VLAD, not HSI fusion. This motivates future adoption of SWIR sensors capturing diagnostic mineral absorption features absent from the 600-860 nm range for planetary SLAM missions.
tldr: HyperLoop首次将高光谱描述子用于3DGS-SLAM回环检测，但Red-NIR波段在岩石地形上增益有限。
motivation: 行星车在视觉重复、无纹理地形中自主导航困难，基于3DGS的SLAM虽能稠密建图，却依赖在感知混叠下退化的RGB外观描述子。该研究旨在解决外星环境中物理不同位置视觉相同所导致的回环检测失败问题。
method: HyperLoop首次将高光谱成像集成到3DGS-SLAM回环模块，以材料级光谱特征补充RGB并增强光照与视觉重复鲁棒性。方法提出BoSW（TF-IDF加权光谱词袋直方图）和PCAK-VLAD（PCA压缩光谱一阶残差统计）两类HSI描述子，并与SIFT-VLAD、NetVLAD在Strict-AND和加权融合下评估。数据集来自DLR的MMOTS，包含四条行星模拟路线的同步RGB-D与高光谱序列，总长65.5 m。
result: 关键发现是传感器Red-NIR波段（600-860 nm）对岩石地形判别力有限：最佳HSI融合SIFT-VLAD+BoSW在Strict-AND下ATE RMSE为5.04 cm，仅比SIFT-VLAD单独4.95 cm差1.8%。相比NetVLAD的8.81 cm，增益主要来自SIFT-VLAD而非HSI融合。
conclusion: 当前Red-NIR高光谱对3DGS-SLAM回环检测提升有限，但该工作验证了高光谱辅助回环的可行性并指出未来应采用可捕获矿物吸收特征的SWIR传感器，以提升行星SLAM任务性能。

title: MicroSDF: Microfacet-Driven Hybrid Neural SDFs for Mixed-Reflectance Surface Reconstruction
abstract: Accurate 3D reconstruction in real-world environments remains a significant challenge due to the coexistence of reflective and non-reflective surfaces, which pose distinct modeling demands. Existing methods often treat these surface types separately, limiting their generalizability and physical plausibility. To bridge this gap, we propose MicroSDF, a novel neural implicit framework that facilitates geometry and reflectance modeling through microfacet theory. Our approach incorporates three core innovations: (i) a microfacet-guided geometry model that extracts multi-scale surface normals (macroscopic and microfacet) from a signed distance field (SDF), regularized by a proposed microfacet normal consistency loss to enforce physically plausible surface orientations; (ii) an enhanced dual-branch color model, where the specular branch leverages the microfacet normals to model high-frequency reflectance, and the vanilla branch, unlike prior works, uses reflection direction (instead of viewing direction) to better model diffuse and low-frequency specular components; and (iii) a detection-guided color blending strategy that adaptively fuses the color outputs based on reflection priors, providing more physically intuitive blending than implicitly learned blending weights. Combined with a tailored multi-stage optimization scheme, the proposed MicroSDF achieves robust and high-fidelity reconstruction across reflective and non-reflective surfaces. Extensive experiments on DTU, Shiny Blender, Ref-NeRF, and DeepVoxels datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, establishing a new direction for physically grounded neural reconstruction.
tldr: MicroSDF 提出微表面驱动的混合神经 SDF，统一重建反射与非反射表面并达到 SOTA。
motivation: 真实场景中反射与非反射表面共存，二者对建模需求不同；现有方法通常将其分开处理，限制了泛化能力与物理合理性。
method: 提出 MicroSDF：微表面引导的几何模型从 SDF 中提取宏观与微表面多尺度法线，并用微表面法线一致性损失约束；增强双分支颜色模型让高光分支利用微表面法线建模高频反射，基础分支使用反射方向而非观察方向建模漫反射与低频高光；检测引导的颜色混合策略依据反射先验自适应融合颜色，并结合多阶段优化。
result: 在 DTU、Shiny Blender、Ref-NeRF 和 DeepVoxels 数据集上取得 SOTA 性能；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: MicroSDF 通过结合微表面理论与神经隐式表示，实现了跨反射/非反射表面的鲁棒高保真重建，为物理驱动的神经重建提供了新方向。

title: Remember, Revisit, Revise: Scaffold Memory for Long-Horizon 3D Geometry
abstract: Geometry foundation models estimate camera poses and 3D scene structure from video sequences, but maintaining consistent reconstructions over long horizons remains challenging. Feed-forward models process long sequences as independent, fixed-length frame windows and align their predictions, causing pose and reconstruction errors to accumulate across windows. Streaming models retain information from past frames to inform future predictions, but cannot revise earlier estimates when later observations reveal errors. To address this, we introduce Scaffold MemOry for Revision (SMORE), a framework equipping frozen geometry foundation models with a revisable external memory for long-horizon inference. Inspired by hippocampal associative memory in biological brains, which links spatial context with sensory experience, SMORE associates where an observer is with what it observes, enabling past observations to be stored, retrieved, verified against new evidence, and revised when inconsistencies are detected. We evaluate SMORE with eight competitive geometry models on five datasets spanning camera pose estimation, multi-view depth estimation, 3D point-cloud reconstruction, simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM), and novel view synthesis. Across all evaluated models, SMORE consistently improves long-sequence pose estimation, reduces multi-view depth error by up to 58%, reduces Chamfer distance for 3D point-cloud reconstruction by up to 43%, and achieves average trajectory error as low as 2.9 cm in long-horizon SLAM. By retaining corrected poses and observations, SMORE further improves the fidelity and spatial consistency of large-scale 3D scene reconstruction. These results establish revisable external memory as a flexible interface for extending pretrained geometry models beyond fixed-context prediction toward iterative, error-correcting inference over long visual sequences.
tldr: SMORE为冻结几何基础模型引入可修订外部记忆，通过“记住-重访-修正”提升长时序位姿与三维重建。
motivation: 长时序三维几何重建中，前馈模型将长视频切分为独立固定长度窗口并对其预测，导致位姿与重建误差跨窗口累积；流式模型虽保留历史信息，却无法在后验观测揭示错误时修订早期估计。因此，需要一种可修订的外部记忆来缓解误差累积并保持长期一致性。
method: 受生物海马体联想记忆启发，SMORE将观察者位置与其观测内容关联，构建可存储、检索、验证并修订的外部记忆，并接入冻结的几何基础模型进行长时序推理。该框架在检测到不一致时利用新证据修正历史位姿与观测，而无需微调原模型。
result: 在8个几何模型和5个数据集上覆盖相机位姿估计、多视图深度估计、3D点云重建、SLAM与新视图合成，SMORE持续提升长序列位姿估计，最多降低58%多视图深度误差、43%点云重建Chamfer距离，并在长时序SLAM中实现低至2.9 cm的平均轨迹误差。保留修正后的位姿和观测还提升了大尺度3D场景重建的保真度与空间一致性。
conclusion: 结果表明，可修订外部记忆可作为灵活接口，将预训练几何模型从固定上下文预测扩展到长视觉序列上的迭代纠错推理。该工作为长时序几何基础模型提供通用增强方案，并有望提升大规模3D重建与SLAM的鲁棒性和一致性。

title: MagicGarment: Benchmarking Single-Image Standalone 3D Garment Reconstruction
abstract: Single-image 3D reconstruction has advanced rapidly, yet standalone garments remain challenging due to thin-shell geometry, open boundaries, and layered structures. Existing datasets and evaluation protocols provide limited support for systematic evaluation in this setting. We introduce MagicGarment, a benchmark for single-image standalone 3D garment reconstruction with 1,518 professionally constructed assets across 17 composite garment types, aligned multimodal annotations, and a unified evaluation protocol. We further establish a garment-aware reference baseline by adapting a pretrained image-to-3D backbone at two levels: Grounded Semantic Refinement (GSR) provides garment-focused visual conditioning, while Flow-Time-Route LoRA (FTR-LoRA) adapts the frozen 3D generative backbone using flow-timestep, token-routing, and expert-load information. Experiments demonstrate MagicGarment's benchmark utility and the effectiveness of garment-aware adaptation. Project page: https://1019538157.github.io/MagicGarment/.
tldr: 提出MagicGarment基准与服装感知基线，用于单图独立三维服装重建评测。
motivation: 单图三维重建发展迅速，但独立服装因薄壳几何、开放边界和层叠结构仍具挑战；现有数据集与评测协议难以支持该场景的系统性评估。
method: 构建 MagicGarment，包含 1,518 个专业构建资产、17 种复合服装类型、对齐多模态标注和统一评测协议；并提出服装感知参考基线，在预训练 image-to-3D 主干上引入 GSR 提供服装聚焦视觉条件，以及 FTR-LoRA 利用 flow-timestep、token-routing 和 expert-load 信息适配冻结的 3D 生成主干。
result: 实验验证了 MagicGarment 的基准效用以及服装感知适配方法的有效性；具体量化指标摘要未提供相关信息。
conclusion: 该工作为单图独立三维服装重建提供了标准化基准和强参考基线，有望推动该方向的可复现研究；项目页面已公开。

title: RDCompGS: Rate-Distortion Optimization for Compression of 3D Gaussian Splatting with Image Codecs
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-quality, real-time novel view synthesis but requires significant storage and transmission resources. Mapping Gaussian attributes to 2D representations enables efficient compression using mature image codecs. However, Gaussian representations that achieve comparable rendering quality are generally treated similarly during optimization, despite substantial differences in coding rate, leading to limited rate-distortion (R-D) performance after compression. To address this limitation, we propose RDCompGS, a 3DGS compression method that enables overall R-D optimization of Gaussian representations with respect to subsequent coding. A differentiable estimate of the coding rate is incorporated into the R-D optimization with rendering distortion. The rate constraint adjustment model further regulates the R-D trade-off across different compression conditions. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that RDCompGS achieves average Bjøntegaard Delta Rate reductions of 37.84% and 49.31% with H.265/HEVC and JPEG XL, respectively. The estimated rate also shows a strong correlation with the actual bit-rate under different compression conditions.
tldr: 提出RDCompGS，将可微码率估计融入3DGS率失真优化，借助图像编解码器实现高效压缩。
motivation: 3DGS虽能实现高质量实时新视角合成，但存储与传输开销巨大。将高斯属性映射到2D表示可利用成熟图像编解码器压缩，然而现有优化常对渲染质量相近的高斯表示同等对待，忽视码率差异，导致压缩后率失真性能受限。
method: RDCompGS将后续编码的可微码率估计与渲染失真共同纳入整体率失真优化，使高斯表示在优化时感知编码码率。方法还引入码率约束调整模型，用于调节不同压缩条件下的率失真权衡。
result: 在三个基准数据集上，RDCompGS使用H.265/HEVC和JPEG XL分别取得平均37.84%和49.31%的Bjøntegaard Delta Rate降低。估计码率在不同压缩条件下与实际比特率表现出强相关性。
conclusion: RDCompGS通过面向后续编码的整体率失真优化，显著提升3DGS压缩效率并验证可微码率估计的有效性，为3DGS的存储与传输压缩提供了有效方案。

title: Holi-Spatial 360: Generative Reconstruction from Sparse Panoramas for Spatial Rendering and Intelligence
abstract: Spatial intelligence requires scalable 3D environments that are both photorealistic and semantically grounded, yet existing indoor datasets are dominated by room-scale captures and costly LiDAR acquisition. Online real-estate platforms offer abundant panoramas of diverse multi-room homes, but sparse viewpoints and texture-poor regions make reconstruction severely under-constrained. We introduce Holi-Spatial 360, a generative reconstruction and data curation framework for converting these panoramas into annotated multi-room 3D environments. Because reconstruction quality bounds subsequent generation, our Correspondence-Guided Geometric Optimization converts feed-forward reconstruction priors into reliable cross-view constraints and builds a coherent 3D Gaussian Splatting representation as 3D spatial memory. Adapted single-image and video priors then restore appearance and complete continuous trajectories while preserving observed content. The reconstructed scenes support arbitrary RGB-D rendering and an automated curation pipeline that combines end-to-end 3D grounding with VLM-based verification. Holi360 contains over 1K multi-room 3DGS scenes, more than 100K instance annotations, and 2M spatial question-answer pairs. We also introduce the Holi360 benchmark to evaluate the spatial understanding of VLMs in real-world, multi-room indoor environments. Experiments demonstrate superior reconstruction and curation quality under sparse panoramic inputs, while fine-tuning VLMs on Holi360 substantially improves spatial reasoning capabilities.
tldr: 提出Holi-Spatial 360，从稀疏全景图生成带标注多房间3DGS场景，并构建数据集提升VLM空间推理。
motivation: 空间智能需要可扩展、逼真且语义丰富的3D环境，但现有室内数据集多为房间级采集且依赖昂贵的LiDAR。在线房产平台有大量多房间全景图，但稀疏视角和低纹理区域导致重建严重欠约束，亟需生成式重建与数据管理方法。
method: 提出Holi-Spatial 360框架，其Correspondence-Guided Geometric Optimization将前馈重建先验转化为可靠跨视图约束，构建一致的3D高斯泼溅表示作为空间记忆；随后适配单图和视频先验恢复外观并补全连续轨迹，同时保留观测内容。重建场景支持任意RGB-D渲染，并通过结合端到端3D定位与VLM验证的自动管理流程生成标注。
result: Holi360包含超过1K多房间3DGS场景、超过100K实例标注和2M空间问答对，并引入Holi360基准评估VLM在真实多房间室内环境中的空间理解。实验表明在稀疏全景输入下重建和标注质量优越，且微调VLM可显著提升空间推理能力。
conclusion: 该工作为从稀疏全景图构建可扩展、语义丰富的3D环境提供了生成式重建与数据管理方案，其大规模数据集和基准有望推动空间智能与VLM空间理解研究。

title: Robust Real-Time Monocular Human Pose Estimation with Insole-Based Sensor Fusion
abstract: Real-time monocular human pose estimation is an important sensing component for human-centered intelligent systems. While recent camera-based methods have achieved impressive accuracy, fundamental challenges persist, particularly when visual observations are incomplete, such as during lower-body occlusion or short out-of-frame intervals. In these challenging but common scenarios, vision-only systems often struggle to reconstruct physically plausible lower-limb motion and reliable foot-ground contact. Due to the highly unobtrusive and wearable nature of smart insoles, this paper investigates whether simple plantar pressure and acceleration sensors can effectively resolve these visually induced limitations. To systematically investigate this, we first collect a synchronized multimodal dataset and then propose a part-decoupled temporal fusion framework. The proposed model fuses foot-sensing features into the lower-body branch to compensate for incomplete visual evidence, while a lightweight coordinator exchanges information between the upper- and lower-body temporal representations to maintain whole-body consistency. The framework is evaluated with three representative real-time visual backbones based on 2D keypoints, 3D landmarks, and SMPL-based human mesh recovery. We evaluate our framework on three representative real-time visual backbones. Quantitative experiments demonstrate that incorporating simple foot sensors consistently improves pose accuracy, motion smoothness, and gait-related measurements over vision-only baselines, with the most significant gains observed under occlusion and short visual-dropout conditions. Ultimately, our results demonstrate that unobtrusive foot sensing provides vital and complementary physical observability when camera observations are temporarily unavailable.
tldr: 提出融合鞋垫压力与加速度传感器的单目姿态估计框架，在遮挡或视觉丢失时提升下肢姿态与步态精度。
motivation: 单目视觉在遮挡或短暂出画时难以重建物理合理的下肢运动与可靠足地接触；智能鞋垫不显眼且可穿戴，有望以简单足底压力与加速度传感弥补视觉观测缺失。
method: 构建同步多模态数据集，并提出部位解耦时序融合框架：将足部传感特征融合进下肢分支，利用轻量协调器交换上下肢时序表征以保持全身一致性；在基于2D关键点、3D landmarks和SMPL的三种实时视觉骨干上进行验证。
result: 定量实验表明，引入简单足部传感器可稳定提升姿态精度、运动平滑度和步态相关测量，优于纯视觉基线，且在遮挡和短时视觉丢失条件下增益最显著。
conclusion: 结果表明，不显眼的足部传感能在相机观测暂时不可用时提供关键且互补的物理可观测性，从而增强实时单目人体姿态估计的鲁棒性。

title: IMU-Bench: Benchmarking Wrist IMU Representations Across Kinematic, Semantic and Clinical Tasks
abstract: Wrist-worn inertial measurement units (IMUs) provide a common sensing modality for tasks ranging from activity and gesture recognition to pose estimation, inertial odometry and clinical motor assessment. Existing wearable benchmarks evaluate performance across multiple tasks, but leave open how supervision for one task affects transfer to others and whether these tasks benefit from a shared representation. We present IMU-Bench, a benchmark of ten tasks from eight datasets for studying IMU multi-task performance and cross-task transfer. We compare six self-supervised methods pretrained on unlabeled recorded and simulated wrist motion, evaluating classification, pose and velocity estimation, and IMU-language retrieval. We find that our masked autoencoder, InrtlWrist, achieves the best or joint-best frozen-probe performance on nine of ten tasks, and fine-tuning improves on training from scratch on nine of ten tasks, including full-body pose, odometry and retrieval. Across transfer and joint-training experiments, supervision that benefits one target can reduce performance on others, with supervised sources transferring within kinematic estimation while, under frozen probing, none approaches the pretrained encoder on language retrieval, and joint-training gains that come at a cost to the paired task. These findings distinguish broad downstream usefulness from complementary task supervision. Code, task cards and a leaderboard are publicly available.
tldr: 提出IMU-Bench基准，系统评测腕部IMU表示在十项任务上的多任务性能与跨任务迁移。
motivation: 现有可穿戴基准虽覆盖多任务评测，但未回答一个任务的监督如何影响其他任务迁移，以及这些任务能否受益于共享表示。为此，本文提出IMU-Bench，以研究腕部IMU的多任务性能与跨任务迁移。
method: 构建包含8个数据集、10项任务的IMU-Bench，比较6种在无标签真实与模拟腕部运动上预训练的自监督方法，评测分类、姿态与速度估计及IMU-语言检索，并开展冻结探针、微调、迁移和联合训练实验。
result: 掩码自编码器InrtlWrist在10项任务中的9项取得最佳或并列最佳冻结探针性能，微调在9/10任务上优于从头训练，包括全身姿态、里程计和检索。迁移与联合训练表明，对某一目标的监督可能损害其他目标；冻结探针下语言检索均不及预训练编码器，联合训练收益常以配对任务性能为代价。
conclusion: 研究区分了广泛下游可用性与互补任务监督，表明共享表示并非对每项任务都有益，并为腕部IMU表示学习、多任务与迁移评测提供公开基准、任务卡和排行榜。

title: Line-Augmented cuVSLAM: Robust Visual Odometry in Low-Texture Environments
abstract: Autonomous mobile robots in warehouses and production facilities operate in precisely the environments that defeat point-feature visual odometry: featureless aisles, uniform walls, repetitive racking and specular floors. Such environments are, however, rich in straight-edge structure: rack uprights, door frames, wall junctions and cabinet outlines present high-contrast linear edges stable across wide viewpoint changes. A line-feature extension to cuVSLAM, a CUDA-accelerated visual-SLAM system, is presented that recovers this signal. Lines are parameterised as Plücker coordinates for geometric transport and as the minimal 4-DOF orthonormal representation of Bartoli and Sturm for optimisation; a Cauchy-robust point-to-line residual with analytic Jacobians is folded directly into cuVSLAM's per-frame Gauss-Newton pose solve, and the same line state is jointly refined in the Schur-complement sliding-window bundle adjustment. An adaptive information weight causes lines to assume more of the estimation burden exactly as point features become scarce, and the extension adds residual blocks to existing solvers rather than introducing a second estimator, reducing exactly to the unmodified point pipeline when disabled. Evaluated in RGB-D mode under SE(3) Umeyama alignment with no scale correction, line features reduce mean absolute trajectory error by 38.5% over the 22 sequences of the TUM RGB-D Freiburg3 collection and by 30.1% over the 8 Replica room and office sequences, where median translation error falls by 38.9% and median rotation error by 66.4%, with zero tracking failures in any configuration tested.
tldr: 提出面向低纹理环境的线特征增强cuVSLAM，通过线特征与鲁棒优化显著降低轨迹误差并实现零跟踪失败。
motivation: 仓库和生产设施中无纹理通道、均匀墙面、重复货架和反光地面会使点特征视觉里程计失效，但环境中存在货架立柱、门框、墙角等高对比直线结构，可提供稳定几何约束。
method: 在CUDA加速的cuVSLAM中扩展线特征：用Plücker坐标进行几何传输、用Bartoli-Sturm最小4-DOF正交表示进行优化，将带解析雅可比的Cauchy鲁棒点到线残差融入逐帧Gauss-Newton位姿求解，并在Schur补滑窗BA中联合优化线状态；自适应信息权重在点特征稀缺时让线特征承担更多估计任务。
result: 在RGB-D模式下采用SE(3) Umeyama对齐且无尺度校正评估，线特征使TUM RGB-D Freiburg3的22个序列平均绝对轨迹误差降低38.5%，使Replica的8个房间和办公室序列降低30.1%；中位平移误差降低38.9%，中位旋转误差降低66.4%，所有测试配置均无跟踪失败。
conclusion: 该工作证明直线结构可显著提升低纹理室内视觉里程计的鲁棒性与精度，且以增量残差块形式嵌入现有解算器、禁用时退化为原始点特征管线，具有较低部署代价和实际应用潜力。

title: Feed-Forward Multi-View Feature Coding for 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods enable efficient reconstruction of 3D scenes from sparse multi-view images in a single forward pass, without scene-specific optimization. However, existing feed-forward scene-coding pipelines first generate a complete Gaussian representation and then encode its geometry and appearance attributes separately, often involving non-differentiable operations. The resulting 'generate-then-compress' pipeline requires complex attribute-specific codec designs and limits rate-distortion performance by restricting the exploitation of cross-attribute redundancy. We propose multi-view feature coding for Gaussian splatting (MFGS), an end-to-end feed-forward framework for scene coding. Instead of compressing an explicit Gaussian representation, MFGS extracts multi-view features from the input images and encodes them into a compact bitstream. Through end-to-end rate-distortion training, MFGS learns compact multi-view features that jointly represent geometry and appearance, enabling the receiver to predict Gaussian attributes from the decoded features. We further introduce importance-guided Gaussian selection to accommodate different rendering budgets, allowing the receiver to adjust the number of Gaussians used for rendering from the same bitstream. Across RE10K, ACID, and DL3DV, MFGS achieves 99.76-99.86% bitrate savings over the generate-then-compress pipeline, as measured by BD-rate, while reducing total GMACs by 52-55% and providing an approximately 12 times end-to-end speedup.
tldr: MFGS 用端到端多视特征编码替代先生成后压缩，实现高效可调 3DGS 场景编码。
motivation: 现有前馈 3DGS 场景编码采用“先生成后压缩”流程，先构建完整高斯表示再分别编码几何与外观属性，常含不可微操作，导致编解码器复杂且难以利用跨属性冗余，限制率失真性能。
method: 提出 MFGS 端到端前馈场景编码框架：从输入图像提取多视特征并编码为紧凑比特流，通过率失真训练学习联合表示几何与外观的特征，接收端由解码特征预测高斯属性；并引入重要性引导的高斯选择，使同一比特流可按渲染预算调整高斯数量。
result: 在 RE10K、ACID 和 DL3DV 上，MFGS 相对“先生成后压缩”流程按 BD-rate 实现 99.76-99.86% 码率节省，总 GMACs 降低 52-55%，端到端速度约提升 12 倍。
conclusion: MFGS 避免压缩显式高斯表示，以联合多视特征编码提升跨属性率失真效率，并支持灵活渲染预算，为前馈 3DGS 场景编码提供高效新范式。

title: Where Should the Gaussians Go? Reusable Label-Aware Allocation for Budget-Constrained Gaussian Splatting of Cinematic CT
abstract: Anatomical labels help 3D Gaussian splatting preserve vessels in cinematic renderings of CT, but the representation is still found by optimising each patient's scene, where densification decides where Gaussians go, while real-time displays cap their number. We address one part of this process: deciding where a fixed budget of B Gaussians should be placed. We propose a reusable, labelaware allocation front end that maps a patient's CT, labels and transfer function to a density over 2mm cells and draws exactly B positions from it without per-patient optimisation; the other Gaussian attributes are still fitted per patient. The front end is learned once from per-patient optimised scenes and implemented as a population-trained neural prior and an interpretable seven-parameter visibility-aware closed form (VACF). With identical attribute fitting on 20 held-out patients at 10K-100K Gaussians, both raise vessel-masked PSNR over uniform allocation by 4.5-7.1dB and over pruning a dense voxel-aligned model by 1.6-3.3dB. The neural prior does not differ significantly from per-patient optimised allocation at any budget, and VACF is within 0.6dB of it on vessels; on 19 external patients the neural prior again matches it on vessels and VACF is within 0.7dB. As an initialisation for position optimisation, VACF allocation beats per-patient densification on vessels at 10K Gaussians and, at 25K, reaches a higher vessel PSNR after 118s of optimisation than densification after 248s. Under altered rendering presets, VACF transfers to new colours and lighting but not to a label-free transfer function, whereas the neural prior shows the opposite pattern.
tldr: 提出可复用的标签感知高斯分配前端，在有限预算下为CT场景选择高斯位置，显著提升血管渲染质量。
motivation: 解剖标签有助于CT电影化渲染中的高斯泼溅保留血管，但现有表示需逐患者优化，致密化决定高斯位置且实时显示限制高斯数量。本文聚焦固定预算B下应把高斯放在哪里的问题。
method: 从逐患者优化场景中一次性学习可复用标签感知分配前端，将患者CT、标签和传递函数映射为2mm单元上的密度并精确采样B个位置，其余高斯属性仍逐患者拟合。前端实现为群体训练的神经先验和可解释的七参数可见性感知闭式模型（VACF）。
result: 在20例留出患者、10K–100K高斯预算且属性拟合一致时，两种方法较均匀分配提升血管掩膜PSNR 4.5–7.1dB，较剪枝稠密体素对齐模型提升1.6–3.3dB；神经先验与逐患者优化分配无显著差异，VACF在血管上差距不超过0.6dB，19例外部队列中分别为匹配和0.7dB内。作为位置优化初始化，VACF在10K高斯时血管上优于逐患者致密化，25K时118s优化后的血管PSNR高于致密化248s。
conclusion: 结果表明可复用标签感知分配能替代逐患者致密化进行预算约束下的高斯位置选择，并可加速位置优化。VACF可迁移到新颜色和光照但不适用于无标签传递函数，神经先验呈相反模式，提示应按渲染预设选择前端。

title: Why 3D Reconstruction Breaks Down on Under-Ice AUV Video, and How to Predict It
abstract: Reconstruction of 3D structures using under-ice AUV video footage has been inaccurate, although it is not certain whether this is due to shortcomings in the methods or an inherent deficiency of the capture system. We test four different models for reconstruction on the same Antarctic under-ice AUV video (Icefin, Kamb Ice Stream): classical feature matching SfM, differentiable photometric splatting, volumetric depth fusion, and a pose-free feed-forward foundation model. All four fail, each in a distinct way: near-total registration yielding almost no structure, geometrically broken output despite healthy photometric metrics, a persistent coverage artifact, and unstable cross-chunk scale. We show that all four are consistent with the same capture regime, a small camera-baseline-to-scene-depth ratio. Following our analysis, we propose a detection system that flags this type of failure in minutes, rather than hours of wasted compute.
tldr: 南极冰下AUV视频上四类三维重建方法均失败，根因是相机基线/场景深度比过小，并据此提出快速失败检测。
motivation: 冰下AUV视频的三维重建长期不准确，但尚不清楚这是重建方法的缺陷，还是采集系统固有的不足。作者需要在同一南极冰下AUV视频上系统比较不同重建范式，并揭示其共同失败机制。
method: 使用Icefin在Kamb Ice Stream采集的同一南极冰下AUV视频，测试经典特征匹配SfM、可微光度splatting、体深度融合和无位姿前馈基础模型四类重建方法。分析各方法的失败模式后，将其归因于小相机基线-场景深度比，并提出可在分钟级标记此类失败的检测系统。
result: 四种方法全部失败且失败方式不同：配准近乎完全失败导致几乎无结构、光度指标正常但几何破碎、持续覆盖伪影、跨块尺度不稳定。这些现象均与同一小相机基线-场景深度比的采集机制一致；所提检测系统可在数分钟内预警失败，而非耗费数小时计算。
conclusion: 研究表明冰下AUV三维重建失败可能主要源于采集几何条件，而非单一方法缺陷。所提快速失败检测系统有助于避免无效计算，并为数据采集策略和重建方法选择提供依据。

title: VisibilitySplat: Ray-Traced Occlusion for Relighting with 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: We address inverse rendering with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) by introducing explicit visibility modeling for relighting as well as material and light decomposition. Our approach augments the standard rasterized 3DGS pipeline with a sparse visibility oracle that estimates transmittance-weighted occlusion for Gaussian primitives from sampled lighting directions. This oracle is implemented using a point-based ray tracer accelerated by a bounding volume hierarchy (BVH) and queried sparsely within the inverse-rendering objectives, while the original 3DGS loop is retained for training efficiency, interactive visualization, and tooling compatibility. Shading follows a physically based rendering (PBR) formulation with a principled microfacet bidirectional reflectance distribution function (BRDF) and low-resolution high-dynamic-range (HDR) environment maps. We evaluate our method on the TensoIR synthetic dataset against baselines based on neural radiance fields (NeRFs), tensor representations, and 3DGS. The results show competitive performance and improvements over several earlier baselines for novel-view synthesis (NVS), albedo reconstruction, and relighting. Ablations indicate that explicit visibility modeling is an important contributor to relighting and material-illumination disentanglement, while pure PBR supervision can favor appearance fitting in NVS. Overall, the findings suggest that sparse, point-based visibility queries effectively complement rasterized splatting for inverse rendering while preserving the practical advantages of the 3DGS ecosystem.
tldr: 为3DGS逆渲染引入稀疏射线追踪可见性，实现材质与光照分解及重光照。
motivation: 现有3DGS逆渲染方法在重光照和材质-光照分解中缺乏显式可见性建模，难以准确处理遮挡与透射效应。本文旨在不破坏3DGS光栅化训练效率和生态兼容性的前提下，将可见性查询融入逆渲染目标。
method: 在标准光栅化3DGS管线中加入稀疏可见性oracle：用基于BVH的点射线追踪器从采样光照方向估计高斯基元的透射率加权遮挡，并在逆渲染目标中稀疏查询。着色采用基于微表面BRDF的PBR公式和低分辨率HDR环境贴图，同时保留原始3DGS训练循环。
result: 在TensoIR合成数据集上与NeRF、张量表示和3DGS基线比较，在新视角合成、反照率重建和重光照上取得有竞争力表现并优于若干早期基线。消融表明显式可见性建模对重光照和材质-光照解耦贡献显著，而纯PBR监督在NVS中可能更偏向外观拟合。
conclusion: 结果表明稀疏点基可见性查询能有效补充光栅化splatting用于逆渲染，同时保留3DGS生态的实用优势。该工作为3DGS重光照与材质光照分解提供了显式遮挡建模思路，并揭示可见性与PBR监督之间的权衡。

title: HyperLoop: Hyperspectral-Assisted Loop Closure Detection in 3D-SLAM for Planetary Exploration
abstract: Autonomous navigation of planetary rovers is challenged by visually repetitive, featureless terrain. SLAM systems based on 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) offer dense mapping but rely on RGB appearance descriptors that degrade under perceptual aliasing - a common failure mode in extraterrestrial environments where physically distinct locations appear visually identical. This paper presents HyperLoop, the first framework integrating hyperspectral imaging (HSI) into the loop closure module of a 3DGS-based SLAM system. Hyperspectral descriptors encode material-level spectral signatures complementing RGB features, providing robustness to illumination changes and visual repetitiveness. Two HSI descriptor families are introduced: Bag-of-Spectral-Words (BoSW), encoding spectral material distributions via TF-IDF weighted histograms, and PCA-K VLAD (PCAK-VLAD), capturing first-order residual statistics of PCA-compressed spectral signatures. Both are evaluated with SIFT-VLAD and NetVLAD RGB descriptors under Strict-AND and Weighted fusion strategies on a custom dataset from the Moon-Mars Outdoor Test Site (MMOTS) at DLR, comprising synchronized RGB-D and hyperspectral sequences across four planetary analog traverses (65.5 m total). A key finding is that the sensor's Red-NIR range (600-860 nm) provides limited discriminability for rock terrain: the best HSI fusion (SIFT-VLAD + BoSW, Strict-AND) achieves 5.04 cm ATE RMSE, within 1.8% of SIFT-VLAD alone (4.95 cm). The gain over NetVLAD (8.81 cm) is attributable to SIFT-VLAD, not HSI fusion. This motivates future adoption of SWIR sensors capturing diagnostic mineral absorption features absent from the 600-860 nm range for planetary SLAM missions.
tldr: 提出HyperLoop，将高光谱描述子用于3DGS-SLAM回环检测，但Red-NIR波段对岩石地形区分有限。
motivation: 行星巡视器在视觉重复、无特征地形中自主导航困难；基于RGB外观描述子的3DGS-SLAM在感知混叠下回环检测退化，地外环境中物理不同地点视觉相同是常见失败模式。
method: HyperLoop首次将高光谱成像引入3DGS-SLAM回环模块，用材料级光谱特征补充RGB；提出BoSW（TF-IDF加权光谱词袋直方图）和PCAK-VLAD（PCA压缩光谱签名的一阶残差统计）两类描述子；在DLR MMOTS自建数据集（同步RGB-D与高光谱、四条行星模拟路线共65.5 m）上，与SIFT-VLAD、NetVLAD在Strict-AND和Weighted融合策略下评估。
result: 最佳HSI融合为SIFT-VLAD+BoSW+Strict-AND，ATE RMSE为5.04 cm，仅比SIFT-VLAD单独4.95 cm相差1.8%；相对NetVLAD 8.81 cm的提升归因于SIFT-VLAD而非HSI融合。Red-NIR 600–860 nm对岩石地形判别力有限。
conclusion: 该工作验证了高光谱辅助3DGS-SLAM回环检测的可行性，但当前Red-NIR波段增益有限；未来需采用可捕获矿物诊断吸收特征的SWIR传感器以提升行星SLAM回环鲁棒性。

title: RDCompGS: Rate-Distortion Optimization for Compression of 3D Gaussian Splatting with Image Codecs
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-quality, real-time novel view synthesis but requires significant storage and transmission resources. Mapping Gaussian attributes to 2D representations enables efficient compression using mature image codecs. However, Gaussian representations that achieve comparable rendering quality are generally treated similarly during optimization, despite substantial differences in coding rate, leading to limited rate-distortion (R-D) performance after compression. To address this limitation, we propose RDCompGS, a 3DGS compression method that enables overall R-D optimization of Gaussian representations with respect to subsequent coding. A differentiable estimate of the coding rate is incorporated into the R-D optimization with rendering distortion. The rate constraint adjustment model further regulates the R-D trade-off across different compression conditions. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that RDCompGS achieves average Bjøntegaard Delta Rate reductions of 37.84% and 49.31% with H.265/HEVC and JPEG XL, respectively. The estimated rate also shows a strong correlation with the actual bit-rate under different compression conditions.
tldr: 提出RDCompGS，将可微码率估计融入3DGS率失真优化，用图像编解码器压缩并显著降低码率。
motivation: 3D Gaussian Splatting（3DGS）虽能高质量实时合成新视角，但存储与传输开销很大。将高斯属性映射到2D可利用成熟图像编解码器压缩，但渲染质量相近的高斯表示在编码码率上可能差异显著，现有优化未加以区分，限制了压缩后的率失真（R-D）性能。
method: 提出RDCompGS，在3DGS压缩中面向后续编码进行整体率失真优化：将编码码率的可微估计与渲染失真联合纳入R-D优化，并设计码率约束调整模型以在不同压缩条件下调节R-D权衡。
result: 在三个基准数据集上，RDCompGS使用H.265/HEVC和JPEG XL分别实现平均37.84%和49.31%的Bjøntegaard Delta Rate降低；估计码率在不同压缩条件下与实际比特率呈强相关。
conclusion: RDCompGS实现了面向后续图像编码的3DGS整体率失真优化，有效提升压缩效率并验证了码率估计的可靠性，对降低3DGS存储与传输成本具有潜在影响。

title: Robust Real-Time Monocular Human Pose Estimation with Insole-Based Sensor Fusion
abstract: Real-time monocular human pose estimation is an important sensing component for human-centered intelligent systems. While recent camera-based methods have achieved impressive accuracy, fundamental challenges persist, particularly when visual observations are incomplete, such as during lower-body occlusion or short out-of-frame intervals. In these challenging but common scenarios, vision-only systems often struggle to reconstruct physically plausible lower-limb motion and reliable foot-ground contact. Due to the highly unobtrusive and wearable nature of smart insoles, this paper investigates whether simple plantar pressure and acceleration sensors can effectively resolve these visually induced limitations. To systematically investigate this, we first collect a synchronized multimodal dataset and then propose a part-decoupled temporal fusion framework. The proposed model fuses foot-sensing features into the lower-body branch to compensate for incomplete visual evidence, while a lightweight coordinator exchanges information between the upper- and lower-body temporal representations to maintain whole-body consistency. The framework is evaluated with three representative real-time visual backbones based on 2D keypoints, 3D landmarks, and SMPL-based human mesh recovery. We evaluate our framework on three representative real-time visual backbones. Quantitative experiments demonstrate that incorporating simple foot sensors consistently improves pose accuracy, motion smoothness, and gait-related measurements over vision-only baselines, with the most significant gains observed under occlusion and short visual-dropout conditions. Ultimately, our results demonstrate that unobtrusive foot sensing provides vital and complementary physical observability when camera observations are temporarily unavailable.
tldr: 提出基于鞋垫压力与加速度传感融合的实时单目人体姿态估计框架，在遮挡和短暂丢帧下提升精度与平滑性。
motivation: 单目视觉实时人体姿态估计在下肢遮挡或短暂出画时视觉证据不完整，难以重建物理合理的下肢运动和可靠足地接触。智能鞋垫具有无侵入、可穿戴特点，本文研究简单足底压力与加速度传感器能否有效弥补这些视觉局限。
method: 收集同步多模态数据集，提出部件解耦时序融合框架：将足部传感特征融合进下肢分支以补偿缺失视觉证据，并用轻量协调器在上肢与下肢时序表征间交换信息以保持全身一致性。在基于2D关键点、3D landmarks和SMPL人体网格恢复的三个代表性实时视觉主干上评估该框架。
result: 定量实验表明，引入简单足部传感器在姿态精度、运动平滑性和步态相关指标上持续优于纯视觉基线，且在下肢遮挡和短时视觉丢失条件下提升最显著。
conclusion: 结果表明，无侵入足部传感可在相机观测暂时不可用时提供关键且互补的物理可观测性。该工作为可穿戴多模态实时人体姿态估计提供了有效方案，并展示了鞋垫传感与单目视觉融合的应用潜力。

title: WorldRecon: Generative Multi-View Mesh Reconstruction for Large-Scale 3D World
abstract: Reconstructing complete, high-quality meshes of large-scale scenes from unposed multi-view images requires faithful geometric grounding while plausibly completing surfaces that are unobserved or only sparsely captured. We present WorldRecon, a generative multi-view reconstruction framework for recovering complete, large-scale 3D scene meshes from unposed RGB images. WorldRecon uses a coarse, noisy global point cloud and camera poses estimated from the input images by a reconstruction model as a global scaffold for whole-scene generation and partitions it into overlapping spatial blocks. To robustly leverage these imperfect geometric priors, we equip the native 3D generative model TRELLIS.2 with a dedicated reconstruction-based conditioning architecture that generates each block from its local point-cloud crop and block-relevant image observations, producing sparse structure, detailed geometry, and PBR materials. To maintain scene-level coherence, we introduce neighbour-aware latent inpainting and a causal world-generation procedure that propagates structural, geometric, and material context across overlapping blocks. Together, these designs scale multi-view generative reconstruction to large-scale scenes, yielding coherent, unified meshes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that WorldRecon achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction performance, reducing Chamfer distance by 14.9% and 43.1% while improving F-score by 17.3% and 12.0% over the strongest baselines on synthetic and real-world indoor scenes, respectively, thereby demonstrating faithful and complete generative reconstruction as well as strong sim-to-real generalization. Project page: https://kszpxxzmc.github.io/WorldRecon-website/.
tldr: WorldRecon 提出生成式多视角网格重建框架，从无位姿 RGB 图像恢复大规模完整 3D 场景网格。
motivation: 从无位姿多视角图像重建大规模场景的完整高质量网格，需要兼顾几何保真与对未观测或稀疏区域的合理补全；现有方法难以同时实现大规模一致性与完整生成。
method: WorldRecon 先利用重建模型估计的粗噪全局点云与相机位姿作为全局脚手架，并将场景划分为重叠空间块；为原生 3D 生成模型 TRELLIS.2 加入基于重建的条件架构，从局部点云裁剪和块相关图像生成稀疏结构、细节几何与 PBR 材质；再通过邻域感知 latent inpainting 和因果世界生成流程，在重叠块间传播结构、几何与材质上下文。
result: 在合成与真实室内场景上，WorldRecon 达到最先进重建性能，Chamfer distance 分别降低 14.9% 和 43.1%，F-score 分别提升 17.3% 和 12.0%，并展现出强 sim-to-real 泛化能力。
conclusion: WorldRecon 证明生成式多视角重建可扩展到大规模场景并输出连贯统一网格，其重建条件生成、邻域潜在修补与因果世界生成设计推动了完整高保真 3D 世界重建。

title: SchemaPose: RGB-Based Category-Level Pose Estimation with Parametric Category Schema
abstract: RGB-based category-level 9D pose estimation remains highly challenging because a monocular system must generalize across unseen object instances while jointly inferring 3D translation, 3D rotation, and 3D size. Unlike instance-level pose estimation, the category-level setting requires the network to learn both what is shared across objects within a category and how individual instances vary in structure. This challenge is amplified in the RGB-only setting, where pose cues, category-level commonality, and instance-specific variation are entangled in appearance without direct geometric constraints, making it difficult for existing frameworks to learn a representation that is truly aligned with the category-level estimation objective. To address this problem, we propose SchemaPose, a schema-guided framework for RGB-based category-level pose estimation. SchemaPose equips the estimation pipeline with an explicit parametric schema for modeling category-level regularities together with structured instance variation, and uses the inferred schema variables to guide pose-related prediction in an end-to-end query-based framework. The same formulation also supports template instantiation, synthetic annotation, and pose learning within a unified framework. Experiments on synthetic and real data show that SchemaPose achieves state-of-the-art performance among RGB-based methods for category-level 9D pose estimation.
tldr: 提出SchemaPose，用参数化类别Schema引导RGB类别级9D位姿估计，在合成与真实数据上达到SOTA。
motivation: RGB单目类别级9D位姿估计需泛化到未见实例并同时推断3D平移、旋转与尺寸，且类别级设置要求网络同时学习类内共性与实例差异。在仅有RGB时，位姿线索、类别共性与实例变化纠缠于外观且缺乏直接几何约束，现有框架难以学到与类别级估计目标真正对齐的表示。
method: 提出SchemaPose，一种模式引导的RGB类别级位姿估计框架；它引入显式参数化Schema来建模类别级规律与结构化实例变化，并在端到端查询式框架中用推断出的Schema变量引导位姿相关预测。该统一形式还支持模板实例化、合成标注与位姿学习。
result: 在合成与真实数据上的实验表明，SchemaPose在RGB类别级9D位姿估计方法中达到最先进性能；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: SchemaPose通过参数化类别Schema统一了类别规律建模、实例变化表示与位姿预测，为RGB类别级9D位姿估计提供了新范式，并在合成与真实场景中验证了其有效性。

title: Back to the Future: Reverse-Consequence Modeling for Long-Horizon Particle Dynamics
abstract: Accurate prediction of object trajectories is fundamental to mechanical understanding and robotic control. However, autoregressive models inherently suffer from cumulative errors, leading to severe drift in long-horizon rollouts. Observing that in many physical systems with dissipative or convergence-to-rest behavior, the final states are often more predictable than transient dynamics (e.g., a sliding object resting under friction or a pendulum stabilizing at equilibrium), we propose ReStep, a cascaded approach that reverses the conventional forward-prediction paradigm. ReStep first employs a stochastic model to directly predict the final state, then leverages Anchored Diffusion to generate goal-conditioned intermediate trajectories. By conditioning on both ''boundary states'', it effectively constrains dynamics and reduces uncertainty, producing physically plausible and temporally coherent transitions. We further integrate ReStep dynamics as the physical engine within a 3D Gaussian Splatting pipeline, enabling a unified physical-visual framework for intuitive inference from images. Extensive experiments on diverse rigid and non-rigid collision datasets show that ReStep achieves superior long-term accuracy, substantially mitigating error accumulation via reverse-consequence modeling.
tldr: ReStep逆转前向预测：先预测终态，再用锚定扩散生成中间轨迹，缓解长时漂移。
motivation: 自回归轨迹预测会累积误差，导致长时推演严重漂移；而在摩擦滑动、摆锤稳定等耗散或趋于静止的物理系统中，最终状态往往比瞬态动力学更易预测。
method: 提出ReStep级联框架：先用随机模型直接预测最终状态，再以Anchored Diffusion生成目标条件中间轨迹；通过同时以两个边界状态为条件约束动力学、降低不确定性，并作为物理引擎集成到3D Gaussian Splatting中，实现从图像进行物理-视觉联合推理。
result: 在多种刚性与非刚性碰撞数据集上，ReStep取得更优的长期预测精度，显著缓解误差累积；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作通过反向后果建模逆转传统前向预测范式，为长时粒子动力学提供物理合理且时间连贯的轨迹，并展示与3D高斯泼溅结合的统一物理-视觉框架在机器人控制与力学理解中的潜力。

title: PUGS: Physics-Guided Uncertainty Modeling for Underwater Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides an efficient framework for dynamic scene reconstruction. Most existing approaches model scene dynamics with deterministic deformation fields, assuming each Gaussian follows a distinct geometric trajectory over time. This assumption breaks down underwater, where light scattering, refraction, marine snow and low visibility create substantial physical ambiguity in captured images. We present PUGS, a physics-guided uncertainty model for underwater dynamic 3DGS. PUGS learns inherent uncertainty induced by underwater image formation and leverages it as a physical signal for dynamic scene modeling. Rather than estimating a single deterministic displacement, it parameterizes each Gaussian's motion as a probability distribution with expected deformation and physical uncertainty. We adopt stochastic deformation optimization to sample Gaussian trajectories via local reparameterization, exploring multiple physically plausible solutions during training. We further propose uncertainty stochastic annealing and a dual-path self-consistency distillation objective, converting stochastic exploration to deterministic reconstruction while preserving temporal coherence. Extensive experiments on underwater dynamic datasets and physics-aware benchmarks demonstrate superior rendering quality, temporal consistency and reconstruction robustness. Our method achieves 1.16 dB PSNR gain over the strongest baseline on UVEB and 3.99 dB on DRUVA.
tldr: PUGS将水下高斯运动建模为概率分布，以物理引导不确定性提升动态3DGS重建质量。
motivation: 现有动态3DGS依赖确定性变形场，假设每个高斯沿确定几何轨迹运动，但水下光散射、折射、海雪和低能见度造成显著物理歧义，使该假设失效，重建质量与鲁棒性下降。
method: PUGS学习水下成像形成过程固有的不确定性，并将其作为物理信号指导动态建模；不再估计单一确定性位移，而是将每个高斯的运动参数化为含期望形变与物理不确定性的概率分布，通过局部重参数化进行随机形变优化以采样多条合理轨迹；进一步提出不确定性随机退火与双路径自一致性蒸馏目标，将随机探索转化为确定性重建并保持时序连贯。
result: 在水下动态数据集与物理感知基准上，PUGS在渲染质量、时序一致性和重建鲁棒性上均优于现有方法；在UVEB上PSNR比最强基线提升1.16 dB，在DRUVA上提升3.99 dB。
conclusion: 该工作表明物理引导的不确定性建模能有效应对水下动态场景的物理歧义，为水下动态3DGS提供了一种鲁棒的概率化重建框架，对真实水下感知与建模应用具有潜在价值。

title: Autonomous 3D Visual-Thermal Inspection for Utility-Scale Solar Farms
abstract: Utility-scale photovoltaic (PV) inspection is dominated by aerial surveys, which are effective for identifying module-level hot cells but provide limited visibility of critical components located under the array, including connectors, cabling, fasteners and structural elements. These assets are difficult to inspect consistently at scale, and their defects are often spatially small, partially occluded and difficult to localise from isolated images. We present an automated 3D visual-thermal inspection system (Tricorder) for under-panel PV asset inspection. The approach combines LiDAR-inertial Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) with geometrically calibrated RGB and thermal imagery and machine-learning-based object detection and segmentation. Detected assets are associated with the reconstructed 3D environment, allowing visual and thermal observations from multiple viewpoints to be spatially fused and localised. We demonstrate the approach on utility-scale PV data for MC4 connector detection and connection-state recognition, thermal anomaly identification, and detection of structural components including bolts, nuts and torque tubes. The results demonstrate a pathway from image-based inspection toward spatially grounded autonomous inspection, where defects are detected and linked to specific assets and their 3D locations within the solar farm.
tldr: 提出融合LiDAR-惯性SLAM与RGB-热成像的自主3D光伏巡检系统，实现板下部件检测与空间定位。
motivation: 公用事业规模光伏巡检主要依赖空中勘测，虽能识别组件级热斑，却难以观察阵列下方的连接器、线缆、紧固件和结构件；这些资产缺陷小、易遮挡，且从孤立图像中难以定位。
method: 提出自动化3D视觉-热成像巡检系统Tricorder，将LiDAR-惯性SLAM与几何标定的RGB及热成像结合，并利用机器学习进行目标检测与分割；检测到的资产与重建的3D环境关联，从而融合多视角视觉与热观测并实现空间定位。
result: 在公用事业规模光伏数据上验证了MC4连接器检测与连接状态识别、热异常识别，以及螺栓、螺母和扭矩管等结构部件检测；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作展示了从基于图像的巡检迈向空间落地的自主巡检路径，使缺陷能够关联到具体资产及其在光伏场中的3D位置，提升板下关键部件的可规模化、一致性检测能力。

title: 4LC: 4D Latent Cache for Efficient Conditioning in Dynamic World Modeling
abstract: For video generation in dynamic world modeling, observed static and dynamic content should be efficiently reused to provide conditions for repeated generation at different times and viewpoints. We introduce 4LC, a 4D latent cache with composite visual representations and a flexible spatiotemporal access interface. As a latent cache, 4LC directly reuses visual representations of static and dynamic content to provide generation conditions, avoiding per-request RGB rendering and re-encoding. As a composite cache, 4LC binds visual representations from multiple visual encoders (e.g., VAE, DINO, V-JEPA, VGGT) to shared geometry and motion, allowing the composite representations to describe the dynamic world with rich information. Besides, we design a flexible spatiotemporal interface, which directly reads the cache at independently specified times and viewpoints and combines readouts across observations, providing a common conditioning format for diverse downstream tasks. Building on 4LC, we develop 4LC-Video to address multiple video generation tasks through different configurations of source observations, spatiotemporal requests, and historical reuse, including camera control, temporal control, novel-view synthesis, scene revisits, and long-term generation. Our experiments show more efficient condition acquisition, effective spatiotemporal controllability, and scene consistency across tasks using a single 4LC-Video model without task-specific fine-tuning.
tldr: 4LC提出4D潜在缓存，复用静态与动态视觉表征，高效条件化动态世界视频生成。
motivation: 动态世界建模中，不同时间和视角的重复视频生成需要高效复用已观测的静态与动态内容作为条件，而逐请求的RGB渲染与重编码会造成效率瓶颈。
method: 提出4LC，将VAE、DINO、V-JEPA、VGGT等多视觉编码器的表征绑定到共享几何与运动，形成复合4D潜在缓存，并提供可按独立指定时间和视角读取、融合多观测读出的灵活时空接口，作为统一条件格式。基于4LC构建4LC-Video，通过配置源观测、时空请求和历史复用支持多种生成任务。
result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标；实验表明，单一4LC-Video无需任务特定微调即可处理相机控制、时间控制、新视角合成、场景重访和长期生成，并实现更高效的条件获取、有效的时空可控性以及跨任务场景一致性。
conclusion: 4LC通过潜在缓存和多编码器复合表征避免重复RGB渲染与重编码，为动态世界建模提供统一高效的条件获取方式；其无需任务特定微调的通用性有望推动多任务视频生成与动态场景建模。

title: PLEDGE: Progressive Lossy Error-Bounded Compression of 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Existing 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) codecs report reconstruction quality after compression, and give users little control over the distortion of individual primitives. We present PLEDGE, a training-free, progressive, error-bounded codec that translates four user-declared tolerances into per-primitive quantization bounds: screen-space position, footprint deformation due to rotation and scale, view-dependent color, and opacity. The bounds apply throughout a declared camera domain, including previously unseen viewpoints. Position and opacity are bounded directly; footprint deformation is bounded under the rasterizer's affine projection model, and color is bounded over all viewing directions. PLEDGE organizes quantized residuals into a progressive bitstream with explicit error bounds for every valid prefix. Experiments across thirteen scenes verify all declared per-mechanism bounds and demonstrate competitive rate-distortion performance. The four tolerances incur substantially different rate costs, so users can spend rate where their application needs it.
tldr: PLEDGE提出免训练、渐进且误差有界的3DGS压缩编解码器，将用户设定的四类容差转化为逐图元量化边界。
motivation: 现有3DGS编解码器通常只在压缩后报告重建质量，用户难以控制单个图元的失真。PLEDGE旨在将用户声明的四类容差转化为可验证的逐图元误差边界，并在包含未见视角的相机域内保持约束。
method: PLEDGE无需训练，将屏幕空间位置、旋转/尺度造成的足迹变形、视角相关颜色和不透明度四类用户容差转化为逐图元量化边界。其中位置与不透明度直接约束，足迹变形在光栅化仿射投影模型下约束，颜色在所有观察方向上约束；量化残差被组织为渐进比特流，且每个有效前缀都有显式误差界。
result: 在13个场景的实验中，PLEDGE验证了所有声明的逐机制误差边界，并取得有竞争力的率失真性能。四类容差带来显著不同的码率开销，用户可按应用需求在相应机制上分配码率。
conclusion: PLEDGE提供了免训练、渐进、误差有界的3DGS压缩方案，提升了压缩失真的控制粒度和码率分配灵活性。其显式误差保证有助于面向需约束渲染误差和渐进传输的3DGS应用。

title: YUBI-Real2Sim: 3DGS Scene Verification for Reliable Policy Evaluation
abstract: Evaluating VLA policies on real robots is costly, time-consuming, and difficult to reproduce, making real-to-sim simulation essential for scalable evaluation. While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables rapid real-to-sim scene generation, the reconstruction quality required for reliable policy evaluation remains unquantified. In particular, policies relying on wrist-mounted fisheye cameras (e.g., YUBI handheld gripper data) are heavily exposed to visual artifacts (holes, floaters) in wide-angle views, directly degrading task performance. To address this, we present YUBI-Real2Sim, a unified framework for 3DGS-based scene reconstruction and real-to-sim policy evaluation under dual fisheye wrist views. We develop an integrated pipeline combining 200-degree fisheye camera capture, 3DGS training, 3D foundation models for object modeling, and MuJoCo-based physical simulation, reproducing the observed real-world policy ordering in eight of nine scene-task comparisons. Using this framework, we construct a benchmark across two bimanual robot platforms, three scenes, three tasks, and dual pi0.5-based policies. This systematically measures real-to-sim rank agreement and evaluates policy sensitivity against counterfactual 3DGS artifacts (ceiling holes, floaters, warping) and capture disturbances. We further analyze whether novel-view quality scores can indicate policy-ranking reliability under a scene-held-out evaluation protocol. The results show task-dependent performance and limitations of quality-based reliability prediction, highlighting the need to assess reconstruction quality when using Real2Sim for policy evaluation. These results do not yet establish a generally reliable scene-acceptance rule. Project Page: https://yubi-real2sim.airoa.io.
tldr: 提出YUBI-Real2Sim，用3DGS和MuJoCo在双鱼眼腕视角下重建场景并评估VLA策略可靠性。
motivation: 在真实机器人上评估VLA策略成本高、耗时长且难以复现，因此需要可扩展的real-to-sim仿真评估。但基于3DGS快速生成场景时，可靠策略评估所需的重建质量尚未量化，尤其腕装鱼眼相机在广角视图下易受孔洞、漂浮物等伪影影响并直接降低任务表现。
method: 提出YUBI-Real2Sim统一框架，面向双鱼眼腕视角进行3DGS场景重建与real-to-sim策略评估，流程整合200度鱼眼采集、3DGS训练、3D基础模型物体建模与MuJoCo物理仿真。构建覆盖两个双臂机器人平台、三个场景、三个任务及两个pi0.5策略的基准，系统测量real-to-sim排序一致性并评估策略对反事实3DGS伪影（天花板孔洞、漂浮物、扭曲）和采集扰动的敏感性。
result: 该流程在九组场景-任务比较中的八组复现了真实世界策略排序；基准揭示性能具有任务依赖性，且基于新视角质量分数的策略排序可靠性预测存在局限。结果尚未建立通用可靠的场景接受规则。
conclusion: 研究表明使用Real2Sim进行策略评估时必须评估重建质量，并凸显3DGS伪影与鱼眼视图对策略评估可靠性的影响；贡献在于提供可复现基准与伪影敏感性分析，为可靠real-to-sim策略评估奠定基础。

title: Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Scene Reconstruction: Methods, Systems, and Trade-offs
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) allows for high-quality real-time novel-view synthesis. Since its inception in 2023, its explicit and highly configurable scene representation has been extended toward sparse-view generation, dynamic reconstruction, efficiency and compression, streaming, and simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM). Although Gaussian Splatting can provide real-time rendering, rendering an existing representation is distinct from constructing, updating, or maintaining the scene itself. In this survey, we synthesize current literature, categorize them and provide a connection of current approaches and tools towards an end-to-end pipeline. Explicitly, we categorize GS scene reconstruction into five overlapping families: single-shot generation, dynamic representations, efficiency and compression, streaming and immersive systems, and Gaussian Splatting SLAM. We distinguish render-only throughput from task-specific scene generation, update, tracking, mapping, and optimization costs, and combine controlled sparse-view benchmarking with native evaluations to identify cross-family quality, latency, memory, and update-cost trade-offs.
tldr: 综述3DGS场景重建方法、系统与权衡，并按五类重叠方向梳理端到端流程。
motivation: 3DGS可实现高质量实时新视角合成，但其显式且高度可配置的场景表示已被扩展到稀疏视角生成、动态重建、效率与压缩、流式及SLAM等方向。然而，渲染已有表示与构建、更新或维护场景本身不同，缺乏对方法、系统与工具链的统一梳理。
method: 本综述将GS场景重建归纳为五类相互重叠的方向：单次生成、动态表示、效率与压缩、流式与沉浸式系统以及Gaussian Splatting SLAM；并区分仅渲染吞吐与任务特定的场景生成、更新、跟踪、建图和优化成本。作者结合受控稀疏视角基准与原生评估，分析跨类别的质量、延迟、内存和更新成本权衡。
result: 摘要未提供具体实验结果与量化指标；仅说明通过受控稀疏视角基准和原生评估来识别跨类别的质量、延迟、内存与更新成本权衡。
conclusion: 该综述连接现有方法与工具，提出面向端到端流程的分类框架，并强调需区分渲染吞吐与场景重建/维护开销。其贡献在于为3DGS场景重建系统提供跨方向权衡分析，可辅助后续研究选型与系统设计。

title: DoReMe: Dual optimization of Reconstruction and Motion estimation for self-navigated free-breathing abdominal MRI using Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Purpose: Free-breathing abdominal MRI is limited by respiratory motion, which introduces image artifacts and k-space inconsistencies. Existing reconstruction approaches often depend on pre-estimated motion fields or external respiratory surrogate signals. We propose a coupled reconstruction-motion estimation algorithm for self-navigated free-breathing acquisition, in which motion is represented by compact Gaussian primitives and jointly refined with the image estimates during iterative reconstruction. Methods: An iterative reconstruction that alternates between data consistency updates and motion modelling was proposed. Respiratory motion was represented using Gaussian primitives. A Gaussian splatting was integrated into the reconstruction algorithm. The method was evaluated on self-navigated free-breathing Cartesian gradient-echo (GRE) acquisition in four healthy volunteers, including retrospective scan shortening experiments, and was compared with regularized compressed sensing (CS) reconstruction. Results: Respiratory motion states were reconstructed in approximately 1.5 min. Compared with CS, the proposed method improved visual image quality, particularly in coronal liver views, and better preserved anatomical structures in retrospectively shortened acquisitions. These findings provide proof of concept for the proposed method. Conclusion: The proposed coupled reconstruction-motion estimation algorithm improved visual image quality compared with CS alone. Gaussian primitives provided a compact and sufficiently flexible representation of nonrigid respiratory motion with practical runtime, supporting further scanner integration and validation in larger cohorts.
tldr: 提出DoReMe，以高斯图元联合优化重建与呼吸运动估计，提升自由呼吸腹部MRI图像质量。
motivation: 自由呼吸腹部MRI受呼吸运动影响，产生图像伪影和k空间不一致；现有重建方法常依赖预估计运动场或外部呼吸替代信号，难以实现自导航采集下的联合估计。
method: 提出交替进行数据一致性更新与运动建模的迭代重建算法，用紧凑高斯图元表示呼吸运动，并将Gaussian Splatting集成到重建中；在4名健康志愿者的自导航自由呼吸笛卡尔GRE采集上验证，并进行回顾性缩短扫描实验，与正则化压缩感知（CS）重建比较。
result: 呼吸运动状态重建耗时约1.5分钟；相比CS，所提方法改善了视觉图像质量，尤其在冠状位肝脏视图，并在回顾性缩短采集中更好地保留解剖结构，但结果仅为概念验证。
conclusion: 该耦合重建-运动估计算法相比单独CS改善了视觉图像质量；高斯图元为非同质呼吸运动提供了紧凑且足够灵活、运行时间可接受的表示，支持进一步扫描仪集成及更大队列验证。

title: RingNav: Task-Shaped Circular Memory for Visual Heading
abstract: Tiny robots have limited computation and memory, yet visual navigation systems often maintain more state than a task requires. We ask whether persistent memory can instead be shaped by the task. We present \textbf{RingNav}, a \(10.6\)k--parameter visual heading estimator that constrains its memory to the circular manifold \(S^1\). RingNav learns only the turn between consecutive images, while heading is composed directly on the circle. On the TartanAir Visual SLAM Challenge, RingNav reduces mean absolute turn error by \(27\%\) and accumulated heading error over $4$ sec by \(15\%\) relative to a similarly sized learned-memory model. The structured update also gives exactly zero turn for identical frames and exact cancellation under sequence reversal. Without fine-tuning, RingNav transfers to real-world drone experiments and continues estimating heading under severe visual degradation. RingNav runs at $27.3$Hz on Raspberry Pi Zero 2W and can be deployed on an ultra-low power GAP8 processor at $33.4$Hz.
tldr: RingNav将记忆约束在圆环S¹上、仅学习帧间转角，以10.6k参数实现低功耗视觉航向估计。
motivation: 微型机器人算力与内存极其有限，但现有视觉导航系统往往维护远超任务所需的状态量。论文提出疑问：能否让持久记忆直接由任务塑形，从而大幅压缩状态与模型规模。
method: RingNav 将持久记忆约束在圆环流形 S¹ 上，只学习相邻图像之间的转角，航向则直接在圆上复合累加而非由网络回归。这种结构化更新在数学上保证相同帧的转角恰为零，且在序列反转时精确抵消。
result: 在 TartanAir Visual SLAM Challenge 上，相比同等规模的学习式记忆模型，平均绝对转角误差降低 27%，4 秒累积航向误差降低 15%；无需微调即迁移到真实无人机实验，在严重视觉退化下仍能持续估计航向；于 Raspberry Pi Zero 2W 上达 27.3Hz，在超低功耗 GAP8 处理器上达 33.4Hz。
conclusion: 该工作表明任务塑形的环形记忆可用仅 10.6k 参数实现鲁棒航向估计，并为超低功耗、小内存机器人平台提供了可部署的视觉航向方案。其结构化零转角与反转抵消特性也为记忆设计提供了可验证的归纳偏置。
